programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: When American soldiers occupied Germany, they faced orphaned German children resorting to looting. Sergeant Mike Bray was assigned to rectify the situation. He earned the children's trust and helped them establish the Young German Christian Association, restoring an abandoned castle for recreation. The children were sad to see Bray go when he left, grateful for his support.

programme.title: Jungle War
programme.desc: In this episode we explore the final years of the war in Vietnam, which saw the United States and her Allies confront the realities of loss and withdrawal from a jungle war. The series concludes with the revolutions that began in the jungles of Cuba and Colombia and changed the course of both nations' history.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Big Battles
programme.desc: The conquest of Italy from the Allied invasion through the various battles.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Big Battles
programme.desc: A detailed look at the aerial battle in the skies over Europe and the bombing campaign against Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Big Battles
programme.desc: The struggle to control the Atlantic and maintain the Allies supply chain in WWII.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Burma Road Campaign
programme.desc: Allied forces from all over the world combine to liberate Burma from the Japanese occupation in WWII.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Burma Road Campaign
programme.desc: The 1937 attack on China by Japan and the historical events that led to this conflict.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The U.S. Army Air Forces
programme.desc: B29 Production goes global as the USAAF steps up its efforts in WWII.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Activities just prior to and including D-Day - Movements of American Troops from all Parts to Poe's Prior to the Normandy Invasion.

programme.title: Visions of War: World War II Women - We Can Do It!
programme.desc: A look at the role of American women in the war effort.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Legend holds that Nazi Germany pillaged France's vineyards, but historians reveal a more complex truth. Through archives, expert voices, and winemakers, this film uncovers profiteering, collaboration, and even wine alcohol sold for V2 rockets, while also highlighting those who resisted in the name of solidarity.
programme.sub-title: Third Reich - Collaboration in the Vineyards

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: No event in the history of cinema had ever been so thoroughly covered. Why so many cameras and equipment to film two atomic explosions just after the end of the Second World War ? Moreover, what's the relationship between atomic testing and the famous bathing suit?

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: Allied convoys resupplying the Soviet Union had to navigate the Arctic, infested with U-boats and enemy aircraft. In summer, dense fog obscured ships despite 24-hour daylight, while in winter, freezing temperatures, ice-covered decks, and permanent darkness made the journey perilous. Veterans recall the constant threat of submarines or icebergs, knowing an attack almost guaranteed death.

programme.title: World War II: The Sound and the Fury
programme.desc: Hitler invades the Soviet Union, but Moscow holds. Japan bombs Pearl Harbor, drawing the U.S. into war. Global conflict escalates as genocide and total destruction define the Axis war machine. In North Africa and Southeast Asia, new battles begin. Operation Torch signals the Allied fightback. In Russia, German troops edge toward disaster at Stalingrad.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: An examination of early U.S. Navy operations, with special attention to bases established in the South Pacific islands and the Doolittle raid.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The U.S. Army Air Forces
programme.desc: Famous Documentary on the B-17 crew and bomber.
programme.sub-title: The Memphis Belle (in Color): Flying Fortress B-17

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Refusing to postpone marriage until the War's end, Nurse Nancy Howard, was determined to be as close to her man as possible. When Lt. Hank Reed was sent overseas as an infantry platoon leader, Nancy enlisted as an Army nurse. Thanks to coincidence and the cooperation of the company Chaplain and the hospital surgeon, the lovers were reunited to return home together for their long-awaited marriage.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Legend holds that Nazi Germany pillaged France's vineyards, but historians reveal a more complex truth. Through archives, expert voices, and winemakers, this film uncovers profiteering, collaboration, and even wine alcohol sold for V2 rockets, while also highlighting those who resisted in the name of solidarity.
programme.sub-title: Third Reich - Collaboration in the Vineyards

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: Outstanding military Naval leaders, soldiers, sailors, and marines are discussed and the Theater commanders of General Dwight D. Eisenhower are also discussed.

programme.title: The True Glory
programme.desc: Introduced by then General Dwight D. Eisenhower and using footage filmed by military photographers, this documentary recounts the historic events from the D-Day invasion to the end of the war. The pre-invasion preparations focus on work in munitions and heavy equipment manufacturing. The D-Day invasion, Operation Market Garden, the failed northern thrust into Holland in the fall of 1944, and more.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: This film is a military documentary told from the point of view of the crew of the aircraft carrier the Fighting Lady -- a pseudonym for the Yorktown.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: This episode will take you on a brave campaign covering the Allied campaign in Italy from December 1943 to June 1944. We focus on the role of General Eisenhower as the Supreme Allied Commander and concluding with the victory in Rome.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: Eisenhower approves a plan to break German lines by Christmas. With just seven days to prepare, Monty ignores warnings, rushes the largest airborne assault ever, and pushes ahead despite rising risks.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: Background of events on Hitler's Ardennes offensive December 1944, with focus on December 19th attack on St. Vith, marking beginning of the Battle of Bulge. Role of 84th infantry division in fighting German army in World War II - penetration of Siegfried Line November 1944, and move into Belgium December 1944.

programme.title: Visions of War: Infantry Weapons and Tactics
programme.desc: Infantry rifle company illustrates combat technique and survival methods applicable to arctic conditions.
programme.sub-title: Combat in Deep Snow and Extreme Cold

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: In an initial failed attempt to become a partner the equal of Germany in the Axis Alliance, Mussolini ordered his troops towards the British positions in Egypt in September 1940. Mussolini, feeling secure in the shadow of Hitler's apparent invincibility, never dreamt that the War between Britain and Italy would culminate in his own death less than 5 years later.
programme.sub-title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The War in Italy

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The victories at Manila and Okinawa are discussed.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won & Lost
programme.desc: A war that reached every continent and touched every sort of terrain demanded a wide variety of strategies and tactics: Dunkirk, Malaya, The River Plate, Operation Market Garden, Syria and The Battle Of Berlin.
programme.sub-title: Jungle & City fighting, Sea Battles, Invasions, Advances & Retreats

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Nothing prepares soldiers to be surrounded by enemy tanks and infantry. When tasked with defending a recently captured town in Bastogne, Belgium, Joe's aging platoon awoke to find themselves surrounded, outnumbered and outgunned. His platoon dumbfounded; Private Joseph Richardson took matters into his own hands. Grasping a bazooka Joe sought to break up the German counterattack.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Burma Road Campaign
programme.desc: The 1937 attack on China by Japan and the historical events that led to this conflict.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The U.S. Army Air Forces
programme.desc: B29 Production goes global as the USAAF steps up its efforts in WWII.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The U.S. Army Air Forces
programme.desc: The US Army Air Force becomes a major weapon in WWII.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Activities just prior to and including D-Day - Movements of American Troops from all Parts to Poe's Prior to the Normandy Invasion.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.desc: As the Second world War rages, watch how America builds up its air power even before getting dragged into the conflict. As early as 1939, President Roosevelt stepped up the production of military aircraft, leading to decisive victories by American forces.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.desc: This episode tackles the exciting story of naval aviations's most powerful weapon system, the Attack Carrier. As one of the weapons that helped win WWII for the Allies, the Attack Carrier was also instrumental in the development of the nuclear age.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.desc: For much of WWII, the German Luftwaffe was virtually indestructible, churning out planes at a rate of one every quarter-hour. By 1944, the Allies turned the tide. The 'Big Week' kicked off on February 20, 1944.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Activities just prior to and including D-Day - Movements of American Troops from all Parts to Poe's Prior to the Normandy Invasion.

programme.title: Embedded 45' Shooting War in Germany
programme.desc: This first episode covers the last week of February to late March. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: Midway was the turning battle in the Pacific. A training film which analyses this great battle from the Commander's viewpoint. Midway was the turning battle in the Pacific. Activities of Marines, Pilots and Sailors are shown before, during, and after the attack.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The leaders of the Pacific are discussed: Chester M. Nimitz, Douglas MacArthur.

programme.title: Sacrifice: From D-Day to the Liberation of Paris
programme.desc: June 6th, 1944, 3 PM: Allies secure beaches; Hitler misjudges, expecting main landings in Pas-de-Calais. Hope rises as French populace anticipates liberation, despite slow Allied progress in Normandy. Paris liberated in August; war persists for another year, marking Normandy's profound sacrifice.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: In 1943 John Ford gave the great cinematographer Gregg Toland (Citizen Kane, The Grapes of Wrath) an opportunity to direct his first film. A veritable epic, framed by a debate between Walter Huston's Uncle Sam and Harry Davenport's Mr. C on the true nature of the Pacific paradise, Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: After a brutal day of relentless combat, the Allies secure a 50-mile bridgehead in Normandy. Now, American, British, and Canadian forces must push inland, capture a major supply port, and liberate Paris. Facing harsh terrain, supply shortages, and fierce German resistance, casualties soar into the hundreds of thousands in this costly battle for freedom.

programme.title: Visions of War: World War II Women - We Can Do It!
programme.desc: Scenes of 1st contingent of 165 women arrive by plane in Honolulu; Women war workers leave their children in nursery schools. Shows scenes at the schools and in industry. Mrs. Roosevelt attends a ceremony honoring nurses who served in the Pacific. Shows women operating a lumber mill, testing tanks, and making guns.
programme.sub-title: WWII WOMEN IN THE NEWS PART 1

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won & Lost
programme.desc: Through history, armies marched to face each other on favored ground and clashed to decide a campaign, a war, an empire. During WWII that changed: Kokoda Australian Campaign, Soviet Finnish war, Kasserine Pass, Burma, Convoy PQ17, Battle of Moscow.

programme.title: The Third Reich in Color
programme.desc: From 1937, colour films also document life in Hitler's Germany. Eva Braun and Hitler's pilot Hans Baur are among the first amateur filmmakers to expose the new celluloid. This creates unique images of the dictator's public appearances and his private life on Obersalzberg. Scanned in high-resolution HD, the footage of Hitler and his entourage unfolds a particularly realistic effect.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: The war reaches new levels of intensity as it drags on, affecting civilian populations like never before. The concept of 'total war' becomes reality, with cities bombed into oblivion, resources stretched to their limits, and entire societies mobilized for the war effort. Strategic bombing campaigns against Germany and Japan begin to devastate industrial centers and civilian morale alike.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: On Sunday morning, December 7, 1941, Japan declares war on the United States by attacking Pearl Harbor and other American military bases in Hawaii. Why did Japan attack American naval bases in Hawaii? What became of the images shot by John Ford and his team? And how did the censored footage of cameraman John Brick reappear one year later?

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: In April 1945, the Yamato, the largest battleship in history, left for Okinawa to destroy American warships and prevent their landing. Weighing 70,000 tonnes and armed with 150 guns, it faced the U.S. naval aviation, including aircraft carriers USS Essex and USS Yorktown. In a fierce battle, American pilots focused on one goal: sink the Yamato. This marked a turning point in WWII naval warfare.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Burma Road Campaign
programme.desc: Allied forces from all over the world combine to liberate Burma from the Japanese occupation in WWII.

programme.title: Military Legends of World War II
programme.desc: Nimitz was Commander in Chief, United States Pacific Fleet and Pacific Ocean Areas on WWII. Promoted to Fleet Admiral in December 1944 he signed for the United States when Japan formally surrendered.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: This episode examines the relations between the United States, the Philippines, and Japan prior to World War II. Then it focuses on the Japanese invasion of Luzon, the take-over of Manila, and the eventual attack and seizure of Corregidor.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Big Battles
programme.desc: The final chapter in the Pacific with the allies eventually wresting control from the Japanese and the bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
programme.sub-title: The Battle of the Pacific: The Setting Sun

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: This episode focuses on the naval war in the Pacific during World War II. It examines the use of two of the U.S. Navy's most important weapons, the submarine and the aircraft carrier, as well as the supply and mail problems facing U.S. operations in the Pacific. It will provide a glimpse of how is life on board of both these vessels.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: Story of America's winter soldier throughout the history of the country from valley forge to the Battle of the Bulge.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: This chapter presents the events that led to America's entry into World War II after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941. It also shows the early setbacks and losses suffered by the Allies in the Pacific Theater, such as the fall of Wake Island, Guam, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Malaya, and Indonesia.
programme.sub-title: America Goes to War in the Pacific

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Metal work on the '67 Coronet is done, so now it's on to the paint booth.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Delayed by numerous issues and setbacks, the 1941 Chevy is finished in the metal shop and ready for paint; fresh paint, new wiring and custom interior take this problem build to the next level.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave is challenged restoring a 1964 Cadillac to its original condition.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and the Kindig team add a tubbed bed and slivered Camaro bumpers to a classic Chevrolet C/K C-10.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The guys need to shake down a 1962 Corvette and make some design adjustments to a '55 Mercedes Gullwing; Kevin hunts for new ideas and rare finds in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A road warrior from Alaska arrives at the shop to add some improvements to an already solid build; to enhance performance, a new exhaust and tips are custom fabricated as well as a new set of wheels, tires and a custom interior.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A simple yet classy Pontiac Tempest arrives for a ground-up build, but things get complicated after the car is completely stripped.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The Pontiac Tempest build continues as bodywork is completed and Dave has designed a killer new color; Kevin shows off his powder-coating skills on a custom chassis.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave restarts work on a 1948 GMC truck that has been sitting in the back of the shop for three years.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kevin take the '67 Coronet, '55 Gullwing and '63 Corvette to a car show in Columbus, Ohio, where they will compete for street rod of the year.
programme.sub-title: It's 1200 Miles to Columbus, and We've Got a Trailer Full of Bitchin' Rides

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave loves anything VW, and he finds a deal for a rare Transporter pickup that is too good to pass up. With a few modifications, he will finish the build, but then his real dilemma begins - whether to keep it or auction it.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A car from Kindig's past arrives back in the shop for an engine upgrade; Dave and Kevin make a trip to Detroit to see the latest technology at Lingenfelter engine builders.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A Karmann Ghia aficionado wants some very specific upgrades for his new purchase. Custom trim, wheels, lowered stance, new paint and new upholstery are some of the items that will give this car a new lease on life.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The pieces that have arrived at the shop are allegedly for a Nova, but the only thing recognizable is the body; the challenge will be to piece car back together and get the body ready so the client can paint it himself.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A client wants his '48 GMC to be Dave's baddest build ever, but when he throws Dave a curveball, it threatens the entire project. Celebrating 20 years in business, Kindig-It hosts a custom car show featuring a slew of past builds.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and the crew start on a 1966 Corvette, but his client doesn't want the color to be anywhere close to its original green.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave comes up with a shade of green that finally gets the client on board.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A past client returns with a 1965 Mustang Fastback, and though he likes the stock look, he wants to upgrade the drivetrain, instrumentation and as many modern amenities as possible; the assembly team gets a crash course in engine tuning.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The crew strives to finish an active-duty serviceman's '51 Ford pickup.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The 1951 Ford pickup is painted and ready for final assembly; the team encounters many problems trying to get it ready for a serviceman who is returning from a year away in a war zone.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: After recovering from a terrible accident where his '32 Ford caught fire, a local business owner wants to see the car fixed as well; diagnosing the fire damage and what caused it is a priority; a 1967 Mustang arrives with a nasty engine vibration.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave designs a Mustang for the ages to compete in the Optima Challenge; the build includes a new front facia and hood and redesigning the rear end.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The 1965 Mustang makes its way through the metal shop and is now ready for paint and final assembly; making it function will test even the Kindig crew.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave has decided that the time is right to design his own concept car from scratch; it's a huge job that involves all the different departments in the shop.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: All the Concept Corvette's elements are built and assembled, but Dave needs to find a buyer; a rock 'n' roll icon brings his '34 Ford coupe to the shop.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A simple repaint of a 1964 Corvette careens into much more after Dave upsells the client on a couple of design features, and the crew finds some damage underneath the original paint; the owner of an iconic Ford GTX1 tasks Dave with solving a dilemma.
programme.sub-title: Just a Couple Heres and Theres

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: An abandoned 1967 C10 that has been sitting for years has been sold to a client who wants a few new touches, but closer inspection reveals more work is needed.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave convinces the client to make the 1967 C10 truck into a convertible; Kevin takes on a new personal project with a Cadillac Escalade.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The engineering on the convertible C10 works in theory, but making it work in practice is the next step; a team brings in a replica 1967 Cobra with a bad engine.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Of all the different years and generations of the VW Bug, there is one that stands out among the rest -- the Hebmüller; there are maybe 200 of them left, so in addition to being hard to find, they are truly the holy grail of VWs.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The build continues, and the challenge is to keep what makes the car a Hebmueller intact, while taking bold steps to turn it into a hot rod. Dave keeps the traditional two-tone exterior, but modifying it to an automatic is a huge test for the shop.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Normally when Kindig-It Design attends a car show, their cars are the ones being judged. But this time around, Dave and Kev hold the keys and will have to select the top 10 builders out of the hundreds of cars that arrive for the show.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave's clients have owned a car since they got married 25 years ago and want it restored so they can enjoy it for another 25. While the shop isn't really into straight restorations, adding some custom pieces and paint makes them "say yes" to the pro.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave is thrilled with the latest build, while KevDogg is barely lukewarm; Dave has done double-cab VWs, Bugs and Karmann Ghias, but now he is taking on something completely different, and even more rare.
programme.sub-title: It's a Barn Door Deluxe, Of Course

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Matching the two-tone paint job is the challenge of the day as the '53 Barn Door Deluxe build carries on; custom trim, a new, more powerful engine, 22 windows and a custom interior all come together to make this surprise worth the wait.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and the guys at Kindig-It proved they could execute Dave's vision of his production Corvette, but now that a few have sold, they have to get them completely finished.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and the team put the finishing touches on the first-ever Kindig CF Corvettes to complete a lifelong dream; however, the clients argue about who will get the first one, all in advance of a once-in-a-lifetime debut at SEMA.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kevin, who have been an absolute treat for automotive enthusiasts for years, come back to the SEMA show with something special on their minds.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A Beatles fanatic challenges Dave to paint a modern Rolls-Royce to match the car John Lennon commissioned in the late 1960s.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kev take the show as far east as they have ever gone and head to Lake George, New York, for the Adirondack Nationals; the town shuts down for the car show, attracting some of the best on the east coast.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A 1970s Pantera is an iconic sportscar, but once Dave gets his hands on it, the style will never be the same; the client has given Dave free rein to change the car as he sees fit, but has one request: he is 6'4" and can't comfortably get in it.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: With the whole team in agreement over the body mods, the crew must make the designs into reality; their list of tasks include bulging out the fenders, creating a spider-shaped exhaust, executing the stretch and getting the car to body.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The Pantera is almost done, but nothing is simple with this car; Dave and Kev get a chance to upgrade their semi rig.
programme.sub-title: Now That Is a Bitchin' Ride

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A 1971 Chevy Nova with tremendous pedigree arrives at the shop to get classic Kindig-It styling cues; Dave wants to make this car into a hardtop; tucked-in bumpers, front valance and a new engine provide a good test for the crew.
programme.sub-title: How Hard Can a Hardtop Be?

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Will makes miracles happen, and Dave decides to make a wholesale change to the car's color; challenges mount at each stage of the build, and the upholstery shop changes up their routine as the client arrives for a reveal years in the making.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: While the shop perfects its process in building the CF1s, word about the car spreads and potential buyers line up; the latest client has a big problem when he can't choose the perfect color combination.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kev take the show to the Midwest, as more than 2,500 cars descend on the Summit Motorsports drag strip for a weekend of fun; Kev gets a ride in a lean, mean drag racing machine; Dave steps up his autocross game.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A client enlists Dave on a mission from God to make his dreams of a father/son road trip along Route 66 come true; getting the client's mechanically unsound reproduction of the Bluesmobile ready for the road will test the crew's mettle.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Kevin Schiele breathes new life into a semi-hauler by giving it a visual and functional upgrade that impeccably reflects his expertise in trucks.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Training the next-generation car builders is near and dear to Dave's heart, and after years of planning, he's finally realized his passion project, the Kindig Academy.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A 1969 Camaro comes in; when Dave and team get a closer look, they determine with the owner that it requires a full rebuild; since the team will be starting from scratch, the client decides to go all-out on the chassis, engine and details.
programme.sub-title: Is There Anything Good on It?

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides

Award-winning program featuring unforgettable, character-driven true crime mysteries, exclusive newsmaker interviews, hard-hitting investigative reports and in-depth coverage of high profile stories.

programme.title: The Son of No One
programme.desc: When he was a youth in the Queensborough projects, Jonathan White (Channing Tatum) -- then known as Milk -- killed a couple of junkies. His dead father's former partner, Detective Stanford (Al Pacino), got him off the hook for the crime. Now a rookie police officer himself, Jonathan remains haunted by the incident. When a Queens reporter (Juliette Binoche) receives anonymous tips regarding the long-ago crime, the implications for both White and Stanford are clear.

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: Steelworker Russell Baze (Christian Bale) works a dead-end job and holds tight to his sense of family, duty and loyalty. Rodney Baze (Casey Affleck), Russell's brother, returns home after serving in Iraq and, with his debts piling up, becomes entangled with a vicious crime lord (Woody Harrelson). Soon afterward, Rodney disappears mysteriously. The police fail to solve the case, so Russell -- feeling he has little left to lose -- puts his life on the line to bring his brother home.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: Street Smart
programme.desc: Jonathan Fisher (Christopher Reeve) is a reporter struggling to keep his job at a magazine. Assigned to write a real-life prostitution exposé, he fails to gain information from his subjects and decides to make up his own story about a pimp. The piece revives his career, but his fictional character turns out to be strangely similar to Fast Black (Morgan Freeman), an actual pimp, who is outraged and demands that Jonathan spill his sources. When the police get involved, matters get even uglier.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Dynamo Is Dead
programme.desc: As he prepares to be buried alive, magician Dynamo embarks on a soul-searching journey, seeking answers to his struggles with mental health through candid conversations with others, including Demi Lovato and Cara Delevingne.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: Angela de Marco (Michelle Pfeiffer) is fed up with her gangster husband's (Alec Baldwin) line of work and wants no part of the crime world. When her husband is killed for having an affair with the mistress of mob boss Tony "The Tiger" Russo (Dean Stockwell), Angela and her son depart for New York City to make a fresh start. Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent (Matthew Modine) looking to use her to bust Tony.

programme.title: A Chorus Line
programme.desc: Hundreds of hopefuls congregate at a cattle call for Broadway dancers. A sour director, Zach (Michael Douglas), and his brusque assistant (Terrence Mann) whittle down the ranks until they're left with 16 dancers. All tell their life stories -- some tragic, some comic -- and explain their love of dance. Tension mounts when Cassie (Alyson Reed) -- once both a big star and the director's lover but now desperate for a part -- auditions. But Zach must choose only the best for his show.

programme.desc: The 20-year arms dealing career of Queens, N.Y., outcast Yuri Orlov (Nicolas Cage) serves as a window onto the end of the Cold War and the emergence of worldwide terrorism. He finds himself reassuring his more ethically challenged younger brother, Vitaly (Jared Leto), while adeptly sidestepping the pursuit of federal agent Jack Lawrence (Ethan Hawke). The globetrotting arms dealer also pursues the woman of his dreams, supermodel Ava Fontaine (Bridget Moynahan).

programme.desc: After a crash that kills her boyfriend, Catherine Tramell (Sharon Stone) has her car searched by the police, who find illegal drugs. Prosecutors handling her case send Tramell to see psychiatrist Michael Glass (David Morrissey). Glass determines that Tramell, a novelist whose books deal with sensational murders, might just be a dangerous person herself. But his findings don't prevent him from embarking on a sexually charged relationship with the cunning cougar.

programme.title: Thick as Thieves
programme.desc: Macklin (Alec Baldwin), a hit man with a passion for rare jazz records, accepts what he thinks is a routine job. The hit turns out to be a setup, though, because Pointy (Michael Jai White), an up-and-coming gangster, wants Macklin out of the way. When Macklin realizes who's behind the setup, the two criminals enter into an increasingly deadly cat-and-mouse game. Before long, the feud expands to include tough female cop Petrone (Rebecca De Mornay) and top Mafia bosses.

programme.title: Ringmaster
programme.desc: Jerry Farrelly (Jerry Springer) hosts a controversial talk show where guests with lurid lives confront each other. After Connie (Molly Hagan) finds her daughter, Angel (Jaime Pressly), sleeping with stepfather, Rusty (Michael Dudikoff), the three are flown to Los Angeles for the program. Starletta (Wendy Raquel Robinson), her boyfriend, Demond (Michael Jai White), and the three women he's been cheating on her with also arrive for the episode. Soon, shameless Demond starts chasing after Angel.

programme.title: Boat Trip
programme.desc: After Nick (Horatio Sanz) makes an insensitive remark, his travel agent decides to get some payback by sending him and his best friend, Jerry (Cuba Gooding Jr.), on a cruise for gay men. As the true nature of their situation gradually dawns on them, they start to get over their feelings of homophobia and meet potential mates. For Nick, love takes the form of a gorgeous model, Inga (Victoria Silvstedt), while Jerry develops feelings for dance instructor Gabriella (Roselyn Sánchez).

programme.title: Meet the Blacks
programme.desc: When some unexpected money comes his way, Carl Black (Mike Epps) moves his family from cold and windy Chicago to bright and sunny Beverly Hills, Calif. As the Blacks settle into their beautiful new home, they start to notice some strange behavior in the neighborhood. Nighttime is approaching, and President El Bama (George Lopez) announces that the annual purge is about to begin. Carl and his loved ones must now endure a 12-hour period of lawlessness before they can enjoy life once again.

programme.title: Fifty Shades of Black
programme.desc: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," Hannah Steele interviews entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) for her roommate's school newspaper. The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work.

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. Her father (John Christy Ewing) disapproves of Kelly's friendship with street dancers Ozone (Adolfo "Shabba-Doo" Quinones) and Turbo (Michael "Boogaloo Shrimp" Chambers), and encourages her to pursue an opportunity to perform in Paris. Ignoring his wishes, Kelly teams up with her friends for a break-dancing benefit show to save an endangered community center.

programme.title: Hendrix
programme.desc: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix (Wood Harris) innovates 1960s rock 'n' roll, then dies of a drug overdose at 27.

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Richard "Cochise" Morris (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs), a local basketball hero, and Leroy "Preach" Jackson (Glynn Turman), who dreams of a career in writing, are likable Chicago high school students in 1960s Chicago. They're into hanging out with friends, pretty girls and the Motown sounds so popular during the era. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry.

programme.desc: The church's greatest enemy became Christ's most prolific messenger. Beautifully shot in the Moroccan desert, Paul the Apostle is a sweeping saga of the man who brought the Gospel to the Western world.

programme.title: Corrie ten Boom: A Faith Undefeated
programme.desc: When Nazi forces invaded Holland in 1940 and began rounding up Jews, Corrie ten Boom, her sister Betsie, and their elderly father risked their lives to save as many as possible. A hidden room was secretly built in their home where the oppressed Jews took refuge until a Gestapo raid put an end to their operation. Corrie ten Boom.

programme.title: Heavens to Betsy 2
programme.desc: Author Betsy Simon (Karen Lesiewicz) finally finds career success when her new novel, Heavens to Betsy, is published. Following advice from her agent (Ruth Kaufman), she tells the public that the book is a work of fiction. After talking with Pastor John (Jim O'Heir from TV's 'Parks and Recreation') she claims that the events portrayed in the book actually happened to her!

programme.title: Inheritance
programme.desc: When the family patriarch dies suddenly, the Delvecchio's are thrown into crisis. Family secrets and simmering feuds between brothers, fathers and sons threaten to undo the family until God intervenes.

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Heavens to Betsy
programme.desc: All Betsy Simon wanted was a little success. An aspiring author of children's books featuring her cat, 'Wishes,' Betsy believes she is about to get her big break. But when she is turned down by a major book publisher, Betsy is devastated. Starring newcomer Karen Lesiewicz and featuring Emmy-Winning actor, Jim O'Heir (Parks and Recreation).

programme.title: We Were There
programme.desc: We Were There captures the voices of America's greatest generation, as they share their stories of duty, service, and responsibility during World War II. While the tumultuous global events of the early 1940's provide the backdrop for this film, it is the men and women recalling their personal stories who take center stage.

programme.title: A Christmas Village
programme.desc: To save her reputation, Piper Jensen, a public relations genius and owner of her own PR company, agrees to work for the owner of a failing Santa's Village and discovers love and how magical Christmas is after all.

programme.title: We are Stronger
programme.desc: We Are Stronger is a faith-based film exploring a veteran's battle with PTSD. While Vic struggles to recover from his physical injuries, reclaim his marriage, and adjust to life after combat, he discovers he can't do it alone. Made in cooperation with the Stronger Alliance, Mighty Oaks, CRU Military, Amos House of Faith, Armed Forces Mission, and more who are dedicated to trauma recovery.

programme.title: The Lamp
programme.desc: Life goes on? A tale of hope, wishes, dreams, and what can happen when you just believe. Two years after the tragedy a visit from a mysterious and magical messenger, who offers Stanley three wishes, just may reawaken his hope for the future. With a little help from a couple of needy foster kids next door, Stanley and Lisa find that all their wishes can come true if they just believe.

programme.title: Grace and Gravity
programme.desc: John Palmer, an American Christian visiting the UK comes across a suicidal British atheist who is about to throw himself off a bridge. Will John convince the man to turn to Christ and live or will John be overcome by his own weaknesses and doubts? Staring Bruce Marchiano (The Encounter) and Richard Brimblecombe (For Love's Sake).

programme.title: The Hiding Place
programme.desc: The heroic true story of a family in Holland that hides Jews and fights the Nazi madness with the only weapon they have. Love. Golden Globe nominated.

45365 explores the congruities of daily life in an American town. From the patrol car to the courtroom, the playground to the nursing home, the parade to the prayer service, it explores relationships and interactions - with people and their environment. The stories of a father and son, a young relationship, cops and criminals, officials and their electorate coalesce into a mosaic of faces, places, and events. 45365 is a portrait of a city and its people. programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.
programme.sub-title: Cantina Culture and the Morning After?

programme.desc: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Potluck Teacher
programme.desc: A sports card clerk becomes an unlikely savior when two clueless teens invite him to their high school. Behind Harrison Jones' ordinary facade lies an extraordinary past that ignites a classroom revolution. Watch as hardened rebels are transformed when Jones cracks their defensive shells and exposes their hidden vulnerabilities. This emotional rollercoaster follows broken teenagers as they find strength through unexpected connections, guided by Jones's mysterious wisdom toward healing.

programme.title: Matters of the Heart
programme.desc: Matters of the Heart follows three couples at different life stages: new lovers discovering each other online, a 13-year marriage in crisis, and longtime partners facing illness-a beautiful tapestry of love, loss, and hope.

programme.title: Was Once A Hero
programme.desc: In a heart-pounding tale of survival, Ginny and her little brother Little Bit are on the run after their father is brutally murdered by the unhinged outlaw Chance and his gang. As they navigate an unforgiving desert, Ginny wrestles with the haunting memories of her father's death and the guilt of taking a life to protect herself. Just when hope seems lost, they encounter Major Malcolm Hunter, a once-great war hero, now battling memory loss and fading into obscurity.

While members of the group look for ways to cope, Hunt begins a summer romance with a young vacationer (Lauren Ambrose).

programme.title: The Great Buck Howard
programme.desc: Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable (Colin Hanks) looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard (John Malkovich), a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback.

programme.title: Tucker & Dale vs Evil
programme.desc: Two scruffy pals' (Tyler Labine, Alan Tudyk) backwoods vacation takes a bloody turn when ignorant college students mistake them for a pair of murderous hillbillies.

programme.title: What Just Happened?
programme.desc: During the course of an ordinary week in Hollywood, movie producer Ben must navigate his way through shark-infested waters as he struggles to complete his latest projects. A demanding studio boss demands extensive changes to a movie starring Sean Penn, while another chief won't greenlight a project unless star Bruce Willis shaves his beard. Meanwhile, Ben tries to reconcile with his wife and maintain a relationship with his young daughter.

programme.title: Flawless
programme.desc: A janitor (Michael Caine) convinces a frustrated executive (Demi Moore) to help him steal gems from their employer, the London Diamond Corp.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: After hearing that her boyfriend/pimp cheated on her while she was in jail, a transgender sex worker and her best friend set out to find him and teach him and his new lover a lesson.

programme.title: First Date
programme.desc: Conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, shy teen Mike's eagerly anticipated first date with the girl next door, Kelsey, implodes as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops and a crazy cat lady. A night fueled by desire, bullets and burning rubber makes any other first date seem like a walk in the park.

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Two college buddies reunite after a decade apart. Ben (Mark Duplass) is married and planning to start a family; Andrew (Joshua Leonard), a free spirit, has spent the last 10 years traveling the globe. Reigniting the rivalries of their college years, the friends agree to enter a movie in an upcoming amateur porn festival. Ben and Andrew's constant need to one-up each other results in a daring proposition: The staunchly heterosexual friends must star together in a gay adult film.

programme.title: Goon
programme.desc: Though a misfit among his brainy family members, Massachusetts bouncer Doug Glatt (Seann William Scott) has a knockout punch that lands him a spot on a minor-league Canadian hockey team.

programme.title: Skate Kitchen
programme.desc: Camille's life as a lonely suburban teenager changes dramatically when she befriends a group of girl skateboarders. As she journeys deeper into this raw New York City subculture, she begins to understand the true meaning of friendship.

programme.title: Touchy Feely
programme.desc: A dentist (Josh Pais) gains the ability to heal his patients' physical pain while his sister (Rosemarie DeWitt), a massage therapist, develops an aversion to touching and being touched.

programme.title: The Square
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when a curator hires a public relations team to build some buzz for his renowned Swedish museum.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Although they're both dating other people, two co-workers (Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson) hang out together in bars and try to ignore their mutual attraction.

programme.title: I Am Love
programme.desc: At a dinner -- during which her husband, Tancredi (Pippo Delbono), learns that he and his son Edoardo Recchi Jr. (Flavio Parenti) are about to assume control of the Edoardo Recchi Sr.'s (Gabriele Ferzetti) lucrative business -- Emma (Tilda Swinton) meets a chef named Antonio (Edoardo Gabbriellini). Antonio and Emma soon find themselves in bed together. With the family already divided over the elder Recchi's unusual plans, Emma's affair is the wild card that might divide the family for good.

programme.title: A Long Way Down
programme.desc: Four strangers who planned to jump off the same roof on New Year's Eve join together as a kind of family and give themselves six weeks to find valid reasons to live.

programme.title: Epic Destinations
programme.desc: Andrea and her sister Sabrina head to spectacular Los Cabos for the adventure of a lifetime, enjoying great design, fresh local foods and a trip to Wild Canyon for a UTV excursion and bungee jumping, before a thrilling afternoon of whale watching.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Emotional and traumatic events of the past and present return to haunt the lives of the women of Drovers Run. The pain of dealing with loss forces each of them to find a way to deal with these life-altering events.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The youngest member of the Drovers Run family is ready to celebrate her 18th birthday in style, but no one seems very interested in helping her mark such a special occasion.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jealousies and family tensions between the Ryan brothers suddenly come to light when an innocent question by Tess re-opens a very ugly wound.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Theft is on everyone's mind since there are cattle duffers working in the district and a flock of Claire's sheep has gone missing.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Claire attends a seminar on artificial insemination with Alex, she leaves Tess in charge of Drovers Run. In spite of a few doubts, Claire gives her a new pair of boots to honour the occasion, and it turns out that Tess will truly have to earn them.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The sudden death of local farmer Max Martin alarms Harry prompting fears of his own mortality, and a sudden drive to defy whatever fate may have in store by pursuing a rapid expansion of his property.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After reaping good profits at the sheep sales, the girls are ready to celebrate with a night at the pub and a bit of Karaoke.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire is finding it difficult to come to terms with Tess's new found relationship with Alex. Her dream of developing a quarter horse breeding program at Drovers Run looks as if it may be close to coming true and she's using it as an excuse to push Tess away.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess finds an old psychology textbook, she becomes obsessed with trying to figure out the real reasons for people's actions. Tess, however, is not prepared for the truths she uncovers about those around her, and also faces something she is reluctant to answer herself.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After a grubby day with the cattle, Tess is delighted when Simon and Briony, two old friends, show up for an unexpected visit. And they've got news, big news: they've got a lease on the café they all dreamed about and they want Tess to come back to the city with them ASAP.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi is in the final stages of arranging a charity polo match as part of her fund-raising efforts for the Miss Gungellan quest, and Brian decides it's high time to reacquaint himself with Becky.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Becky brother Sean visits and she is secretly thrilled, seeing it as her chance to stop Sean from going down the same path as their jailbird older brother. Peter arrives to check on Claire's progress training the quarter horses, and their flirtation takes a new turn.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Becky is thrown from her horse and injured when someone takes a shot at her. Claire and Peter's relationship is deepening and they are spending virtually twenty-four hours a day together as they seek out horses for training.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: It's a dry spell and the women are suffering shared baths, stained washing, and unflushed toilets. Claire cleans out an old bore to water her stock, but the newly-discovered water soon dries up when Nick irrigates his barley crop.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When a good looking charmer arrives out of the blue at Drovers Run, no-one is more surprised than Jodi to find out he is her father, who has returned after an 18-year absence.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Preparations for the Miss Gungellan ball continue, and Meg is faced with the difficult decision of whether to stay at the place she loves or to leave with the man she loves.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire's relationships are fragmented. She and Becky are barely speaking, and Tess is now living in Melbourne, unaware of recent events.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Jodi's cooking gives five young men food poisoning, the women of Drovers must convince the Killarney men to put on a strip show.
programme.sub-title: You Can Leave Your Hat On

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Drovers Run is cleared out by thieves while Jodi and Craig take advantage of everybody else's absence from the ranch to enjoy a secret rendezvous in the spa.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire is irritated over Tess's three homestay guests: they're starting to shear today, and the last thing she needs is tourists getting in the way.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire and Alex's potential clients are being put off by rumours circulated by Peter that, ten years ago, Alex was responsible for crippling a boy, Stefan Van Amstel when he deliberately ran his car off the road.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: On the eve of the Gungellan Show, Claire is presented with repossession papers for Drovers Run. Nick and Tess become estranged after Tess walked out on him, but she tries to explain her actions of the previous night.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Peter offers to stop the repossession of Drovers Run if Claire marries him, but she rejects his proposal. She is injured in a fall during the Stockman's Challenge and the accident reveals her pregnancy. In order to help Claire, Alex steps forward to claim paternity.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire returns to Drovers Run after her stay in the hospital, but she must deal with the lie she told that Alex is the father of her child when he isn't.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Harry lends Claire his prize bull, which upsets Tess for not being consulted. Jodi returns from her holiday and Alberto proposes to her. With Becky's blessing, a date for the wedding is set, but three weeks is a bit sudden for Meg.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi is busy making plans for a huge wedding that is becoming too much for Alberto's liking and Meg's finances. When Alberto informs Jodi that her mother is intending to sell her jewels to pay for the event; Jodi decides a simple, traditional wedding may be better.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: With last-minute wedding preparations underway, Jodi's father blows in unexpectedly, which creates tensions in the family.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The charade of being the father of Claire's baby is causing problems for Alex, especially when Sandra Kinsella appears on the scene.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Jodi receives a mysterious chain letter, she discards it immediately. Further misfortune soon strikes Drovers Run, with Terry falling ill and the discovery of a dead sheep.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: A mob of Emus descends upon Drovers Run, wreaking havoc on everything they encounter. The chaotic situation is just one more stress for Claire who is struggling to balance the demands of motherhood with that of running the ranch.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Determined to prove herself during a Fire Service training weekend, Jodi quickly realises it's going to be far more difficult than she had anticipated. Meanwhile, Meg is dedicating herself to her studies and is thoroughly immersed in 'Pride and Prejudice'.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Becky and Jake join in a business partnership with Claire and Tess; Claire has issues with some of Jake's clients.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia shares three simply delicious Italian classics - a Shaved Fennel, Radish, Red onion and Prosciutto Cotto appetizer. Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini take the stage for her main course and a light Olive Oil Cake is a perfect finish to the meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American cuisine has a unique history and continues to evolve with time. Lidia will demonstrate one of the traditional favorites - Spaghetti with Meatballs - before sharing a more contemporary Pork Chop Milanese that is a favorite in one of her restaurants.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia shares three simply delicious Italian classics - a Shaved Fennel, Radish, Red onion and Prosciutto Cotto appetizer. Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini take the stage for her main course and a light Olive Oil Cake is a perfect finish to the meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grandma Erminia's favorites grace today's menu and include a Rice & Pea Soup; a simple Prosciutto Cotto sandwich and a dish that the family finds on many Sunday menus: Baked Stuffed Shells.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The tradition of kneading dough has always been around in Lidia's family. She recalls kneading with her grandmother as a small child and continues to do it with her own grandchildren today. In this episode, she prepares a buttery, flaky Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta, a delicious Butternut Squash and Brussels Sprouts Panzanella using leftover bread, and finally Pappardelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminisces about her childhood chores, which included milking the goats and helping her grandmother prepare ricotta and other cheeses. In this episode, she will celebrate the culture of cheese and prepare the following recipes: Crostini Two Ways, using Tomato and Ricotta plus Kale and Fontina. Her next recipe is a hearty and cheesy dish of Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The beautiful Adriatic Sea was a big part of Lidia's childhood, as she loved to play on the rocky beach and savor the bounty of the local waters. She prepares Linguine with Clams and Broccoli, a twist on the classic linguine con vongole. She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement, even though she had to flee there to avoid the communist regime in her hometown of Pula. She and her family stayed with her Zia Nina, whose influence on Lidia's cooking is still seen in her recipes today. Recipes include Mussels Triestina, Orange & Raspberry Spritz, and a Coffee Panna Cotta made with a light, sweetened cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia attended school near the beautiful city of Trieste before coming to America and picked up many essential skills from the nuns who ran it. Inspired by the soups she had for school lunches, she prepares a Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup, as well as a one pot meal of Sausages and Apples that can feed a hungry family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter always proved to be a tough time for the garden, but this only made cold weather crops more valuable on Lidia's family table. Recipes in this episode include a delicious Orecchiette with Breadcrumbs, Pancetta, and Cauliflower, and a unique and flavorful Cabbage Salad topped with a warm dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's first home economics class as a teenager in New York confirmed her passion for food. Despite the differences compared to what she was used to, she was determined to explore it all. Lidia starts off with Lasagna with Ricotta and Mozzarella, a dish she remembers from when she was first introduced to Italian American food. She follows this with a flavorful Escarole Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes, and finishes with Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a very satisfying mixture.
programme.sub-title: Cooking as a Kid in New York

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The fig tree at Lidia's current home reminds her of her time growing up in Istria, where they would grow fruit trees. This brings back memories of eating the sweet fruits grown on the trees and playing amongst them. Recipes in this episode include a Roasted Pork Loin with Dried Cherry Sauce and an elegant Fennel and Asian Pear Salad that bursts with flavor.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a teenager in the seventies, Lidia was always curious about Italian-American cuisine, which was extremely popular especially in New York City and all the boroughs. Today she honors the Italian-American culinary culture and prepares a Chicken Parmigiana Light, a leftover Meatball Panino, and a Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs, and Eggs, which will be sure to leave everyone satisfied.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The 1980s brought a lot of Northern Italian cuisine to New York City. This made Lidia feel at home, as a lot of the flavors central to her childhood were now with her in America. Today's recipes include a Pasta Primavera "New School," which her kids always loved growing up, and the classic Raspberry and Walnut Cookies, a beloved Italian American staple.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia was in her 20's, she opened Buonavia, her first restaurant, in Queens, New York. Her menu there included Italian American favorites, served alongside some of her favorite dishes from her homeland. In this episode, she prepares popular dishes from this first eatery including: a rich and flavorful Beef and Potato Goulash, and a sweet and simple Crespelle with Wild Cherries, Chocolate, and Whipped Cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia constantly cherishes the memory of baking bread with her Grandma Rosa. As simple as it was, there is nothing that could take away how powerful this culinary experience was for her. Lidia starts off with a quick and easy Onion Tomato Focaccia, and then talks about Taralli, crunchy little bread rings that are a treat in southern Italy. She then makes Pizza Rolls with two uniquely Italian fillings- broccoli rabe and sausage, and ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The arrival of Italians into America demanded the need for Italian products as well. This resulted in more creativity and flavor in the kitchen, as Italians began to grow their produce in America. Lidia makes a Belgian & Red Endive Salad as well as a sweet Cherry Jam Tart wrapped up in an almond crust.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up around goats, who loved to play and run, but also produced the most delicious milk which would then be used to make ricotta. Here she makes light and pillowy "Naked" Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings. She then prepares an easy, sweet Open Cookie Cannoli. Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As Lidia works in her garden, she reminisces about her childhood and of the lessons that Grandma Rosa taught her about her vegetable patch. In the kitchen, she makes a Country Salad as well as Green Beans with New Potatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

Today, Lidia prepares a Fig and Prosciutto Bruschetta, a delicious combination of sweet and salty. She then transforms wafer cookies into Quick & Easy Truffles. Finally, it's time for a light and airy Almond Tart from Andria.

programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring the Lidia's family to the table. programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is a celebration of some of Lidia's favorite comfort foods. The combination of potaoes and pasta in one dish is not unusual in Italy and in her Pippette with Sweet Potatoes, Lidia adds a beloved American ingredient to give it a nutritious and complex finish. Veal Stew with Onion and Squash is the perfect one-pot meal, in which the protein and vegetables come together.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Preparing a delicious and nutritious weeknight meal for the family is not always easy but Lidia shares some of her quickest and simplest recipes that willw ork in any kitchen. The menu includes: carrots and Apple Salad, Salmon Fillets with Prosecco served with Savory Potatoes and Apple Crumble- a dessert that can be made with almost any fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Who doesn't love comfort food? In this episode, Lidia shares some of her most requested and delicious comfort food recipes: Pasta and Bean Soup; Decadent ham in Marsala Sauce; and her italian version of one of America's favorites: Hamburger and Homemade Ketchup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia prepares three regional Italian dishes- from Piedmont to Tuscany to Emilia Romagna. Her colorful Peppers Piedmontese are a great addition to any antipasto or buffet table, her Malfada Michelangelo Style is a delicious pasta dish based on dish attributed to Michelangelo. lastly, she shares a Filet Mignon Italian Style with Balsamic Reduction using this liquid gold from the area of Modena.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the Soup and Sandwhich concept shortly after she arrived in America. And soups are one of her favorite creations to make. In this episode, she prepares a velvety Spinach and ChickpeaSoup; an Italian style Baked Toast Sandwhich and to finish, she enjoys some oatmeal crepes with her grandson Ethan.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's episode features a collection of the best of Italian dolce or sweets- from cookies to cake to pudding. Lidia begins this episode with Anise Cookies, then prepares a Mint Granita, a light and heavenly Angel Cake with Fresh Berries, and lastly a Rice Pudding with a Blessing, inspired by one of the convents in Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has enjoyed clamming with the locals in Le Marche as well as in Long Island, and in this episode she shares two of her most popular dishes: Pappa al Pomodoro with Clams is based on the Tuscan classic-tomato and bread soup. Clam and Scallion Risotto, is a delicious variation of the beloved Linguine with Clams.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has shared her love for gnocchi and passing on traditions for years, and in this episode she makes the gnocchi out of cheese.The comforting meal includes: Lentil Country Salad, Cheese Gnocchi with Butter and Sage Sauce, and Pork Pockets Stuffed with Pickles and Cheese.
programme.sub-title: Gnocchi Time Memories with the Grandkids

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.sub-title: The Versatile Tomato and All things Italian

Barnaby and Jones must try to find out what really happened to the Lamberts - and whether the case has a link to the missing woman.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

Druid high priest Leticia Clifford shows Barnaby that sacred ley lines run through the stone circle and later is convinced she has made an exciting discovery.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are sampling the local cider at Midsomer Abbas spring fair when the body of a missing tax inspector is found floating in the cider vat. As Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder they uncover an array of motives.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones enter the cloistered and old-fashioned world of Midsomer Priory after a nun is found strangled. Later, the nuns discover that a valuable silver altar set has vanished, then the chaplain is found murdered.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed.
