programme.desc: Martina McBride serenades Jillian and one lucky guy.

programme.title: 70% Club, The
programme.desc: Oprah Winfrey, The New York Times, and ABC Nightline have all reported that 70% of black women are single. But this group of friends never thought they would be part of the statistic. As they prepare one friend for 'I Do' and another for divorce; secrets, lies, and betrayal threaten to derail the wedding. As they each struggle to hold on to their relationships the women can't help but wonder if it's even possible to find lasting love, especially for a black woman?

programme.title: Cream
programme.desc: When cash-strapped Cassie finds success dancing in a nightclub, under the name CREAM, the pursuit of cold, hard cash, leads hers into doing private parties, and soon working as an escort. CREAM is about to learn that big money comes at a big price.

programme.title: No Such Thing as Loyalty
programme.desc: Two men's loyalty is tested when a very ungrateful and needy female comes in between their friendship. Will she divide Darnell and James or will their loyalty to each other overcome the dangerous game she playing. With all being said, James didn't make it no easier either.

programme.title: Enter the Dominion
programme.desc: Media giant Jonathan Zander is known for his take no prisoners business attitude. Under suspicion, Zander must find a new, trustworthy person for his organization. When he meets the talented, yet socially challenged, Sheldon Marcus, he finds the perfect tool to funnel his next business deal through. The affects of this deal could cause damage, but He will stop at nothing to increase his profits.

programme.title: The Queens Ball
programme.desc: Racine Robinson is the queen pin of a criminal empire, alongside her daughters Cand and Kat. Racine is celebrating her 50th birthday and invited all the regional crime families to come and celebrate. Unbeknownst to her, a contract has been taking out to kil Racine on her birthday. With government intervention, and various talking heads, the death of Racine could lead to open warfare in the city.

programme.title: Before 'I Do'
programme.desc: A game of Russian roulette. There are scandalous secrets and a cover up, and three people, bound to take them to the grave. Before 'I Do' draws you into the realm of passion and love, lust, lies, and friendship. A fast-paced, colorful, action drama with a splash of comedy and a myriad of surprises.

programme.title: Christian Brothers
programme.desc: Three very different brothers try to navigate their lives and relationships through the streets of Compton.

programme.title: Same Girl
programme.desc: When brothers learn they both have been dating the same girl, a competition ensues, for who can bed her first.

programme.title: Trip Slip
programme.desc: Three homeboys plead with their wives to let them have one night out to celebrate what they consider an achievement - the end of paying child support.

programme.title: Innocent Shots
programme.desc: After their stash was broken into, cousins Lake and Bobby take out the perpetrator. Tensions begin to rise, and their rival Marcus begins to suspect foul play. Then an old friend, Shame, returns to the streets after dropping out of college and he begins to play both feuding hustlers, hoping to succeed on his own.

programme.title: And They Named Her Love
programme.desc: Love, a hopeless romantic painter, sets out on a cross country journey to find herself in the competitive world of artistry. When a near death experience brings Atlanta based songstress Nasada into her life, she goes on a journey to find out that love and business do not always mix.

programme.title: Love Unexpected
programme.desc: Chase is a young and confident college student, who is a self-proclaimed "ladies man" but also feels that love is for suckers. That is until he meets his match Kary, the fiercely independent student who isn't interested in wasting time on anything casual. Chase sees Kary as a challenge and the ultimate prize, but is he willing to give up his playboy ways for true love?

programme.title: Thicker the Berry the Sweeter the Juice
programme.desc: Cherish Denice is a young and voluptuous woman, who goes from nerdy to owning her big beautiful self. She's constantly pushed to the friend-zone by various men she encounters, and ends up with nothing but a broken heart. When she falls for the bad boy next door, Khalil, she finds that self-love can be more important, than her own idea of "love."

programme.title: Everything I Never Expected
programme.desc: Opposites attract when a spoiled bachelor and a broke college grad accidentally become roommates. Forced to cohabitate in a less-than-ideal apartment, they clash, prank, and eventually fall for each other. Life challenges and misunderstandings complicate their budding romance, but true love prevails.

programme.title: Smash and Dash
programme.desc: Clarence, a Chef from Chicago, is very passionate about two things, food and love. After being jilted at the altar, Clarence's friends Lakeith and Buddy, immediately urge him to get back into the dating pool, but under one condition, and that is for him to "Smash and Dash." Clarence needs to hook up with as many women as he possibly can through a dating app without falling in love.

programme.title: Letters from the Bottle
programme.desc: An accomplished writer finds his way back to his work after experiencing a tragedy.

programme.title: Queen of the Trap House 2: Taking the Throne
programme.desc: Kionna has taken full control of her dead boyfriend's drug empire. She has taken the throne to become the official Queen of the Trap House. However, a new man steps into her life causing her to shift focus away from the criminal enterprise. Kionna also begins dealing with new enemies from rival drug gangs to law enforcement. Kionna will now need to show everyone what a true Queen does to maintain power.

programme.title: The House Sitter
programme.desc: A young college student takes a job as a house sitter and ends up in a deadly game of hide and seek.

programme.title: Taboo
programme.desc: In the wake of a tragic emotional event, Angie Dobson is lead to do the unthinkable. She suffers from a history of sexual abuse. Instead of suppressing her feelings, she over indulges to satisfy her appetite for an unhealthy infatuation for her brother. These family secrets have been swept under the rug for years. Will this family be able to bounce back? Or will this family be torn apart from the acts of this Taboo.

programme.title: Bunny and Clive
programme.desc: Down and out alcoholic reporter Dougie Pierce has been faced with losing his job for not bringing in a reputable report of anything that is worth reading. That is until one day he runs into the city's most notorious duo in crime Lola and Clive aka "Bunny & Clive". When he becomes their hostage, he gets a full on one-on-one interview with this criminal power couple and why they do what they do. He has the most important story of this generation, that is if he makes it out alive to tell it.

programme.title: Enter the Dominion
programme.desc: Media giant Jonathan Zander is known for his take no prisoners business attitude. Under suspicion, Zander must find a new, trustworthy person for his organization. When he meets the talented, yet socially challenged, Sheldon Marcus, he finds the perfect tool to funnel his next business deal through. The affects of this deal could cause damage, but He will stop at nothing to increase his profits.

With government intervention, and various talking heads, the death of Racine could lead to open warfare in the city.

programme.title: Snow Black
programme.desc: Sarah Camden, a special operations soldier with PTSD, returns home to bury her mother. She realizes that she has to rid her hometown of gangs, drugs and crooked politicians. Sarah calls in her special ops buddies to clean up the town.

programme.title: Dawgs 4 Life
programme.desc: A story about four best friends who grew up on the south side of Chicago faced with poverty, drugs, jealousy, betrayal, and murder. They realize that all that they have is each other, when in reality, nothing is what it seems. Bound by a pact of loyalty, truth, and dedication to one another, it's money that causes they're alliance to break apart.

programme.title: The Queens Court
programme.desc: The Queens Court is an underground, all female organization that rules on all criminal activity in the city. Nothing is done without the queens courts verdict first, and those who fail to comply will be dealt with, by any means necessary.

programme.title: My Shattered Life
programme.desc: After a teenager resolves his own unfortunate circumstances, he's faced with another one that will not only affect him and others close to him, but the community.

programme.title: Ultimate Betrayal
programme.desc: Jerry, a recently unemployed accountant, and his wife Stephanie face financial struggles after Jerry loses his job. They invite Jerry's best friend and mentor, Lionel, a music producer, to stay with them. Lionel turns out to be manipulative and begins a rivalry between Jerry and his friend Shawn. Lionel also tries to seduce Stephanie by exploiting her financial vulnerability. This betrayal leads to a chain of events that ends tragically, revealing a dark side of Jerry that he never knew existed.

programme.title: Don't Shoot
programme.desc: After the unarmed shooting of William King, a college bound black teen, by two white officers, a city is on fire as it seeks justice in these times of racial division.

programme.title: Jab Pyar Kisi Se Hota Hai
programme.desc: Suraj (Salman Khan) is a carefree philanderer who falls in love with the woman of his dreams, Komal (Twinkle Khanna). After being pursued for a while, Komal agrees to accept Suraj's proposal for marriage, only if he renounces his reckless lifestyle and bad habits within six months. While he tries hard to accomplish the goal, an eight-year-old boy shows up at his doorsteps claiming to be his son born from an old fling. Suraj is in a dilemma as he takes a liking to the young boy.

programme.title: Hadh Kar Di Aapne
programme.desc: Accusing each other of infidelity, the court refuses to accept Anjali (Ritu Shivpuri) and Sanjay's (Nirmal Pandey) divorce plea until they each can prove other's infidelity. Anjali seeks her friend, also named Anjali's (Rani Mukerji) help to spy on Sanjay. Meanwhile, Sanjay hires his detective friend, Raj (Govinda), to gather evidence of his wife's infidelity who he believes is on the tour. Raj does so with hilarious results, in this comedy of errors brimming with hilariously confusing drama.

programme.title: Bhramma.Com
programme.desc: Envied by the lifestyle of Rameswaran (Siddharth), his brother Kameswaran (Nakhul) pleads to Lord Bramma to swap his identity to someone else to enjoy a happy life. However, an interesting turn of events lead Kameswaran into a mess. How he overcomes his troubles forms the plot.

programme.title: Sharafat Gayi Tel Lene
programme.desc: Prithvi Khuranna (Zayed Khan) is a middle class working professional. One fine day, a mysterious amount of 100 Crores is credited into his bank account. It is allegedly done by a top notorious don. Prithvi calls up his roommate Sam (Rannvijay Singh) to share the news with him. Just when the duo is busy planning as to what to do with the whopping amount, the bank's Vice President D.K. Thawani (Anupam Kher) lands up at his doorstep to offer his personalised service to his esteemed customer.

programme.title: Bheja Fry 2
programme.desc: A simpleminded tax collector and a business tycoon evading an impending income-tax raid meet on a cruise ship. The tycoon ploys to knock the collector off the ship, but instead, they get stranded on an isolated island.

programme.title: Kanni Madam
programme.desc: Kathir (Vishnu) and Malar (Chaya Devi), an intercaste couple, elope from Madurai and head to Chennai in fear that their parents won't give consent to their marriage. However, an unfortunate accident turns the life of Malar upside down.

programme.title: Sharmaji Ki Lag Gayi
programme.desc: Professor Sharmaji is quite a prude but happens to be the sex columnist of Jhunjhuna Samachar, a weekly newspaper owned by a wealthy and influential man Murli. Things stir up and cause trouble in paradise when Sharmaji gets married to a pretty young woman named Shobha and she starts getting unwanted attention.

programme.desc: Ambedh (Samuthirakani), a high court lawyer and social activist, gets on the wrong side of the government, prompting them to get his son and friends killed. Meanwhile, an eloped young couple face grave danger from their casteist relatives. How their lives interact forms the nucleus of the movie.

programme.title: Ward 126
programme.desc: A young man is found dead in his house. While the investigation shows the darker side of the IT proffessionals, the murder to be solved becomes a mystery.

programme.title: Chori Mera Kam
programme.desc: Bholanath (Shashi Kapoor), the long-lost son of a police officer, is raised by a veteran thief, Mr. John (David Abraham). Bholanath carries out petty robberies along with his female accomplice and ex-girlfriend, Sharmili (Zeenat Aman). While carrying out a heist, the duo stumbles upon an unpublished manuscript for a book titled, 'Chori Mera Kaam', a how-to-do-it guide on stealing. They sell the manuscript to a shady publisher and it ends up becoming a nationwide bestseller.

programme.title: Halla Bol
programme.desc: Ashfaque, an idealistic small town boy joins the street theatre group of Sidhu, a reformed dacoit to learn the basic tenets of acting. On relocating to Mumbai, his luck shines and he becomes a superstar in no time. However, success comes at a high price for Ashfaque and he is forced to compromise the very principles he grew up with. Ashfaque's dishonesty alienates him from his family and he begins to feel lonely in the world of superstardom.

programme.title: Sattam En Kayil
programme.desc: After an accident, Gowtham hides a body in his car, but things take a turn when he's arrested for drunk driving, and the car is impounded at the police station without anyone noticing. What follows is a series of unexpected twists and complications. Can Gowtham navigate this escalating crisis and find a way out?

programme.title: V1
programme.desc: A forensic officer, who suffers from nyctophobia, sets out to investigate a murder and tackles multiple challenges to find out the real truth.

programme.title: Thirumbipaar
programme.desc: A gifted sound designer with extraordinary hearing stumbles upon dark secrets, pulling him into a tangled web of murder, mystery, and shocking revelations.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: A wealthy businessman and his wife die in a plane crash, leaving behind their nine-year-old son, Abbas Khan (Abhishek Sharma) to inherit their wealth. Police suspects that their death was not an accident. Fearing Abbas's life might be in danger too, a personal bodyguard, Inspector Rajveer Singh (Sunny Deol) is assigned to protect Abbas. After training rigorously at the Police Academy to eliminate hardened criminals, Rajveer, is underwhelmed by his first assignment.

programme.title: Dil Ka Rishta
programme.desc: A wealthy and charitable young man, Jai Mehta (Arjun Rampal) visits a deaf and dumb school and falls in love with one of its teachers, Tia Sharma (Aishwarya Rai). When Tia introduces her fiancé, Raj (Priyanshu Chatterjee), Jai is left heartbroken and takes up drinking. One night, inebriated Jai's car collides with Raj and Tia's. The impact instantly kills Raj and critically injures Tia. When Tia gains consciousness, she is unable to recollect her troubled past.

programme.title: Tango Charlie
programme.desc: Indian Army Sepoy Tarun Chauhan (Bobby Deol) is assigned to proceed to Northeastern region of India that has been rocked by riots and violence with orders to report to his superior, Havaldar Mohammed Ali (Ajay Devgn). Once there, he comes to know that things can be quiet for weeks, following by sporadic violence and casualties on both sides. Then a war breaks out between India and Pakistan and their battalion gets deployed to Kargil to guard a bridge.

But out in the deep Atlantic, an unfathomable life-form soon ensnares the boat. As members of the crew now succumb to a strange infection, Siobhán must overcome her alienation and win their trust -- before everyone is lost.

programme.title: Skyline
programme.desc: Jarrod (Eric Balfour) and Elaine (Scottie Thompson) take a trip to Southern California to visit his friend, Terry (Donald Faison), for a fun getaway, but it turns into a weekend of terror. During the night a cluster of strange, mesmerizing lights signals the arrival of an alien invasion. As thousands of terrified people are pulled into the maws of giant alien ships, Jarrod and his companions must use every skill they have to survive global genocide.

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: A drive-in favorite, this sci-fi classic follows teenagers Steve (Steven McQueen) and his best girl, Jane (Aneta Corseaut), as they try to protect their hometown from a gelatinous alien life form that engulfs everything it touches. The first to discover the substance and live to tell about it, Steve and Jane witness the blob destroying an elderly man and grow to a terrifying size. But no one else has seen the goo, and policeman Dave (Earl Rowe) refuses to believe the kids without proof.

programme.title: Eraserhead
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: The Host

programme.title: Affliction
programme.desc: In a small New Hampshire town, washed-up cop Wade Whitehouse (Nick Nolte) has a troubled past, an abusive father (James Coburn), the contempt of his ex-wife (Mary Beth Hurt) and an unimpressive streak as a lawman. When hunting guide Jack Hewitt (Jim True) reports a businessman's accidental death during a hunting trip, Wade believes he has a chance to turn around his life, if he can prove it was murder. Increasingly obsessed, Wade begins to lose his composure during the investigation.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
programme.desc: On a family vacation in Switzerland, Bob (Leslie Banks) and his wife, Jill (Edna Best), become friendly with a man staying in their hotel. When the stranger is assassinated in their presence, the vacation turns dangerous. Before dying, the stranger passes along a secret to Jill. Then, to keep the couple silent, a band of foreign assassins kidnaps their daughter. Offered no help by the police, Bob and Jill hunt for their daughter as they try to understand the information that they have.

programme.title: Red Riding: 1974
programme.desc: When a young girl goes missing, Yorkshire Post crime reporter Eddie Dunford (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a series of mysterious child murders that date back several years and mirror to the current case. He faces stiff opposition from the local police and his editor, Bill (John Henshaw). Eddie's troubles escalate when he becomes involved with a moody widow (Rebecca Hall) who has a mysterious connection to wealthy developer John Dawson (Sean Bean).

programme.title: Red Riding: 1980
programme.desc: Six years after his first visit to Yorkshire, England, detective Peter Hunter (Paddy Considine) returns to look into the town's high murder rate. Though the deaths have been occurring with alarming regularity over the years, the police have done little to find the killer, who's now known as the Yorkshire Ripper. As Hunter discovers mysterious irregularities in the case, he realizes corrupt police officers (David Morrissey, Warren Clarke) are doing everything they can to stop his investigation.

programme.title: Red Riding: 1983
programme.desc: Ten years after the body of a mutilated girl was found in Yorkshire, another young girl is missing. Lawyer John Piggott (Mark Addy) is asked to re-examine the conviction of a disabled man who confessed to the earlier murders and now claims he dis so under intense police pressure. As Piggott looks into whether the Yorkshire police tortured their suspect, Detective Jobson (David Morrissey) starts to regret his brutal past and reveals a secret that casts the entire case in a new light.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the Carnegie Library Homestead, in Homestead, Pennsylvania. This Library was the site of violent riots between Carnegie and the steel workers. It is said that Carnegie built the library to win the steel workers over. It is thought that steel workers or Carnegie himself could be haunting the building. Some of the reported activity includes shadow figures, books falling off shelves, apparitions, and voices.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hawaii's Plantation Village, which was once a sugar plantation. It it is now an outdoor museum with reports of spirits still wandering the property and the many authentically replicated homes. It is believed that some of the entities seen are those who committed suicide or were murdered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS and Jason's daughter, Haily, head to Napanoch, New York to investigate the Shanley Hotel. Since its opening in 1845, The Shanley Hotel has been plagued by an abundance of inexplicable deaths and tragic events targeting children. One of these tragic stories involved a little girl named Rosie, who died as she fell down a well while playing with friends. Some of the reports are of apparitions and toys moving in various rooms of the hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Niagara Falls, NY to investigate paranormal activity that has been reported at Rapids Theater. Claims revolve around an actress who is said to have hanged herself backstage. People have heard the sound of high heels, whistling, doors opening and closing on their own and apparitions have being seen around the stage and bar areas.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Snug Harbor, in Staten Island, New York. The team is very excited to be joined by Meredith Vieira, who will help them investigate this large property that includes historic landmark buildings. The investigation focuses on a lady in white who has been seen floating throughout Snugs Harbor. She is believed to be a laundry worker, known as a Matron, who was murdered by her thirteen year old son, who she kept chained inthe basement.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to Jefferson City, Missouri to investigate Missouri State penitentiary. Having opened in 1836,it stood as oneof the oldest and most violent prisons in America, and was referred to as "the bloodiest 47 acres". While still operational, both guards and inmates reported strange experiences at the penitentiary. It continued even after its doorsclosed. Some of the activity reportedincludes apparitions of men and women, doors slamming, and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to one of the oldest distilleries in America, Buffalo Trace, in Frankfort, Kentucky. Operating since the 18th century, its former president, Colonel Blanton, is believed to still be roaming the buildings. He worked and lived at the distillery for over 55 years, before passing away at his home, which was on the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Ohio to investigate Kings Island, an amusement park that sits on land that was the site of an awful accident. The workers here believe the people who died in the accident could be the ones still visiting the park. Some of the reported activity includes the sound of laughter, footsteps, objects being thrown, and a girl in a little blue dress who is said to be the ghost of a child buried in the nearby cemetery.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Naples, New York, to investigate the Naples Hotel. This hotel was built in 1895. There was a suicide at the hotel in the 1920's, which is when the activity is said to begin. The owners believe the ghost of the victim is still there and have nicknamed him "Topper." Some of the reported activity includes apparitions, voices, and objects being thrown.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hales Bar Dam and Marina in Tennessee, to investigate a dam that was built on Native American land. It is believed that a Cherokee chief cursed this property after he was forced off it. Due to numerous problems, Hales Bar Dam took eight years to complete and was finally finished in 1907. During the building of this dam there were many tragedies such as accidental deaths, including workers being buried alive in cement walls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates a 19th century Bed and Breakfast in Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee, built by the Cloyd family. Over the years, many members of the Cloyd family passed away at this property. The current owners, the Coles, believe the Cloyds never left and are haunting the hotel. People have seen several full body apparitions, matching the descriptions of various Cloyd members. Whistling has been heard, a lady in pink has been seen as well as a man in black.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS, minus Grant, answers a call for help from Providence City Hall where paranormal activity is threatening the staff. And now there is also concern for the hundreds of citizens who pass through this building every day. Built in 1878, this prominent building has the city's history tucked away between its walls, including a ghostly former mayor who is refusing to leave office...even when on the other side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out to investigate the U.S. Naval Institute in Annapolis, Maryland, where a marine's death remains a mystery and his ghost still roams the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's final case draws near, but that doesn't stop the TAPS team from helping those in need. They head to Mount Joy, Pennsylvania to investigate Bube's Brewery to see if the late owner, Alois Bube, and his deceased family members are still presiding over the lager business. Alois purchased the brewery in 1876 and added on a Victorian hotel to serve his beer and accommodate overnight guests.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: As Grant's final show is now just a case away, the team revisits an old favorite of his, Mt. Washington in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire. Not only was this the resort Grant honeymooned at 15 years ago but it later became a location that provided incredible evidence for the team. Now there are new claims and more areas and rooms open to the TAPS team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For Grant's last episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team decides to stay close to home and investigate Jason and Grant's very own Spalding Inn. GHI investigated their Inn before, but this will be TAPS' first opportunity. The Spalding Inn was originally a summer home named Cherry Hill House that began taking in guests in 1865. It was renamed the Spalding Inn in 1926 when Randall and Anna Spalding took over.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the first episode back since Grant made his announcement that he wasleaving, TAPS pushes forward focusing on the case on hand. They head to the University of Rhode Island to investigate a Fraternity house that has been experiencing paranormal activity for decades. Purchased in 1936, a former Governor once resided in the house, and there is a claim that his little girl, Abigail, fell to her death there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. This historical Jail was the final destination of America's first female serial killer, Lavinia Fisher. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out on their first case since co-founder Grant Wilson left. This case takes them to New Orleans, Louisiana to investigate what's locally known as the Upstairs Fire at Jimani Lounge. The current owner, Jimmy Jr. was only 12 years old when an arsonist set fire to his father's club on June 24th, 1973. 32 men died trying to escape, but because these men were associated with the gay community, many bodies were never claimed, therefore, victims were never identified. Jimmy Jr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to Alexandria, Louisiana to investigate the Alexandria Zoo, where the apparition of the longtime zookeeper and manager, Les has been seen. Les' longtime friend, Bill Hess called in TAPS after many longtime employees and friends noticed strange paranormal activity that reminded them of their dear friend. TAPS also introduces a new member, Ashley to the team and Jason promotes Adam to his new position, Investigator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate Fort Ontario, a place that was the only location in America to provide sanctuary for Jewish refugees during World War II. Built in 1755, this fort first saw battle during the French and Indian war, and is no stranger to bloodshed. ...and phenomena.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Joliet, Illinois to investigate that Rialto Square Theater. In the 1920's the Rialto Square Theater hosted famous entertainers and vaudeville stars. But in the 1930's an accident took place right outside the theater where a little boy was hit by a car and then later dies inside. People in the theater have since claimed to see the little boy, who they named Kevin, and experienced other eerie paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Claremont, New Hampshire to investigate a former shoe and furniture factory, the Topstone Mill. What was once an abandoned space has now become a restaurant and bar... with frequent visitors from "the other side." Could deceased workers from the 1900's be trying to contact a mother and son team who own the bar? TAPS has surprising evidence that could point in that direction.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lockport, New York to investigate an underworld of tunnels. It holds a mystery of possible murders, multiple deaths and frightening phenomena. What stories do the spirits of Lockport Caves want to tell? Will TAPS be able to reassure their client that visitors will be safe if they venture on one of the longest underground boat rides in America? Next up, the team travels to Skaneateles, New York to investigate the Fuller House.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hampton Falls, New Hampshire to investigate the Governor's Mansion, a property Steve has investigated before with a local team. Could this estate's hauntings be connected to a sad secret surrounding a little boy who is believed to have once lived here in the late 1800's? Will TAPS be able to reach this child and find out if he was in fact the hidden legitimate son of State Senator, Warren Brown? Could the State Senator have been behind his murder?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Bowling Green, Kentucky to investigate Western Kentucky University. This University was established in 1906 and has 20,000 students attending. Tamela Smith is the client, and has called TAPS in to figure out if some of the stories that have been passed down over the decades are folklore or truth. There are three main stories that surround the school.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Rochester, New York to investigate the Rochester Public Library's 15 years of claims. There's reason to believe that two deaths associated with the building could be behind the activity. The library wants to go public with the phenomena but only if accurate. Can TAPS find the answer they are looking for and finally let the public in on this library's long-held secret?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS returns to Hartford, Connecticut to investigate the Mark Twain House. With their previous investigation marred by malfunctioning equipment, TAPS is being called back to look into new and frightening claims that could finally uncover who is residing there. Will Samuel Clemens' favorite holiday initiate an appearance from the famous author? Or will his three children try to reach out to TAPS?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to San Juan Capistrano, California to investigate the San Juan Capistrano Mission. This mission has been in the community for 236 years dating back to the Spanish Colonial. An earthquake in 1812 buried 40 people in the rubble; including a teen age girl named Magdalena. The legend goes that she was dating a boy her father disapproved of, and had to do penance at the alter. As she walked up to confess, the earthquake began and she was buried alive.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Bartonville, Illinois, to investigate Peoria Asylum. The owners are renovating this building and have noticed a lot of paranormal activity since they started their restorations. Built in 1898 and opened in 1902, it is said that 16,000 people died there, from multiple reasons, including, patients killing patients and suicide. The asylum's records hold two key figures; Dr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cortland, New York to investigate The 1890 House. Industrialist, Chester Wickwire built this home for his family, and even though they have long passed, it's believed by some that the family may still reside here. Michelle, the caretaker, is concerned that the spirits may follow her home. Do the Wickwire's still live in their former home and if so, can TAPS help put Michelle's mind at ease that they mean her no harm?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the oldest operating steamboat in the United States. The boat was built in 1914 and has been used for everything from dances to gambling. Its former Captain Winters was legendary for being somewhat shady. It's claimed that he killed a deckhand named Floyd during an argument when he sent him to do work on the paddle wheel and then ordered full steam ahead, which killed Floyd.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Sylvan Beach Park in Sylvan Beach, New York to investigate a theme park originally built in the 1890's. Sylvan Beach Park used to be referred to as the Coney Island of Central New York, with its famous hotels, lakeside attractions, and amusement rides. Now Sylvan Beach holds a haunted history and TAPS has been asked to investigate, much to the unease of some of the employees who fear the investigation will agitate the spirits further.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate the Shreveport Auditorium, a place that is famous for introducing Elvis to the world. Shreveport Auditorium opened in 1929 and is considered a national landmark. The auditorium's stage has been graced by such stars as Hank Williams and Johnny Cash and is known as the first place Elvis preformed professionally. A statue of Elvis was erected after he passed and that's when the phenomena is said to have begun.
programme.sub-title: The Ghost Hasn't Left the Building

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Little Rock, Arkansas to investigate a personal case at the Jones House and their bungalow next door. Robberies, fires, assault, and murder have all taken place in the old bungalow, dating back to 1898, when Ed Cornish had his wife and two children die 16 hours apart. Then in 2005 Bonnie Wallace, the Jones' neighbor, was murdered by an acquaintance in the bungalow and her husband, Paul died shortly after from illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Liberty, Missouri to investigate the Belvoir Winery; a property that has four buildings that are being renovated to become a retirement facility and winery. These buildings were at one time an orphanage, an old folks home, a hospital, and a nursing home and have seen over 10,000 deaths through the years.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Elms Resort & Spa in Excelsior Springs, Missouri was built in the 1880's to accommodate the thousands of visitors flocking to the area, which had rapidly gained a reputation of having mineral springs with magical healing powers. The first Elms Resort was opened in 1888 and burned down in 1898. They opened a new hotel in 1912 (which has recently been renovated).

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Monticello, Arkansas to investigate The Allen Mansion, built in 1906 by a wealthy businessman named Joe Allen. He lived there with his wife and three daughters. One of Joe Allen's daughters, Ladell is believed to have committed suicide in the mansion at the age of 54 years because of her divorce and later losing her son to pneumonia.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate two buildings that may share the same paranormal activity. The client, Grayson owns the 1800's era Rendall Building, which is across the street from the second building with activity, the Caddo Parish Courthouse. They are thought to be connected because it's believed that the The Rendall building's basement once acted as a cold storage facility for those who were hanged at the Courthouse.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hyde Hall in Cooperstown, NY to investigate a cursed family home. George Clark started building Hyde Hall in 1817 with the intension of it being a showplace for Clarke's agricultural empire and to remind him of his childhood in England. George died in 1835 on the southern porch before completion and his son, George Jr., took over the property. This was followed by a contentious relationship between George Jr. and his mother.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In 1863, the Battle of Gettysburg spanned 3 days and was the bloodiest conflict of the Civil War. 97,000 Union Soldiers and 75,000 Confederate Soldiers fought resulting in 51,000 casualties and one civilian fatality in a town that normally only has a population of 2,400. On the 150th Anniversary of the Battle, TAPS is called to Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, by one of Jason's good friends, Mark Nesbitt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Buffalo Naval and Military Park has called upon TAPS to investigate three vessels that all saw gunfire and bloodshed during their time of service. The ships that will be investigated are a cruiser named USS Little Rock (the largest), a destroyer named USS The Sullivans, and a submarine named USS Croaker, (the smallest). USS Little Rock has reported deaths on it.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Octagon Hall was built by Andrew Jackson Caldwell in 1847. Andrew and his wife, Elizabeth helped Confederate Soldiers during the Civil War by setting up a hospital room, where many of the soldiers died. They also built tunnels and passageways where the Confederate Soldiers could hide from the Union Soldiers. Andrew's wife and son died of Typhoid Fever during the war and his daughter, Mary Elizabeth, died when her dress caught on fire in the kitchen and she burned to death.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Belle Grove Plantation sits in King George, Virginia. It is now a bed and breakfast, but the plantation played an important role in American History. James Madison, the 4th president, was born here, and John Wilkes Booth crossed through the property after he assassinated President Lincoln. The armed contingent searching for Booth stayed at Belle Grove Plantation the night before they caught and killed him.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home as they investigate the Cumberland Library & Monastery in Cumberland, Rhode Island. A massacre that occurred in the spring of 1676 may have been the first of several events to cause the paranormal activity that exists today.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to Brunswick, Georgia to investigate Brunswick Old City Hall. Chief Tobe Green has asked the team to investigate reports of paranormal activity that has gone on for years. Construction began in 1889 and by 1890 the top floor was used as the municipal court. In 1890, Officer Robert L. Massey was shot and killed here while trying to arrest a man who was found guilty for a minor offense. Unexplained activity has been reported ever since.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates the abandoned Elizabeth V. Edwards Elementary School in Barnegat, New Jersey. Built in 1930, this was first Barnegat High School until a larger one was built in 1957, turning this into an elementary school. In 1975 the school was renamed Elizabeth V. Edwards. Elizabeth was someone who dedicated her entire life to the education of Barnegat's young people. She passed away in 1965. The school was shut down in 2004.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The prestigious Cincinnati Music Hall has welcomed famous composers and entertainers ranging from Igor Stravinsky and Richard Straus to Ella Fitzgerald and Bruce Springsteen. But it's the "the dead" that have shined a light on this historical building. In 1878 the central hall was first constructed and a year later the north and south halls were added to accommodate the industrial exhibitions that were so popular at the time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates five different locations along one of the most haunted streets in America! Main Street in St. Charles, Missouri was built on top of a cemetery, which at one time housed hundreds of bodies. As St. Charles grew, it became inconvenient to have a cemetery in the middle of the city and in 1850 it was decided that bodies should be moved to another area. However, not all of them were removed and buildings were constructed over them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Carthage, Missouri to investigate the Burlingame & Chaffee Opera House. The building has multiple floors and has had various uses over the decades, starting in 1878 when the second floor was an Opera House, the lower level, a hardware store and the basement a mortuary. In the early 1900's the building was sold to Charles E. Turner who owned a carriage and harness company.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stay close to home as they investigate two neighboring buildings: Stadium Theatre and Stadium Building in Woonsocket, Rhode Island. Original owner, Arthur Darman constructed the building and the theatre in 1926. His vision for the theatre was to bring live entertainment to those who couldn't afford to travel to New York. The adjacent building was a community hub, which featured doctors' offices, law firms, dentists, and insurance agencies.

programme.title: Empire of the Sharks
programme.desc: In a water-covered future, humans pay tribute to a warlord, who rules the last land & is guarded by intelligent sharks. After a prisoner escapes, a rebellion ignites against the warlord & his sharks

programme.desc: When a violent supernatural cult known as Death's Messengers reigns terror on Earth, a team of malevolent storybook villains is coerced into fighting in the modern world, but these baddies must learn to keep their true wickedness at bay if they want any chance at freedom.

programme.title: American Warships
programme.desc: When a fleet of mysterious ships wage war against the Earth, only the crew of the USS Iowa can prevent global armageddon

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Driven by a horde onto sacred Native American grounds, our Heroes find two distinct halves of the same tribe trying to survive two separate ways. The "zunami" is bearing down on them all and their very survival at stake.

programme.title: Ice Sharks
programme.desc: As scientists study the effects of climate change on marine life under Arctic ice, a new breed of shark breaks through, forcing the scientists to fight back.

programme.title: Range 15
programme.desc: A group of veterans find that the zombie apocalypse has spread across the United States. Together, they must fight their way across the country and find a cure for the outbreak and restore freedom before it's too late.

programme.title: AVH: Alien Vs Hunter
programme.desc: A galactic hunter chases the most dangerous alien creature in the universe to planet Earth, where humanity is caught between predator and prey.

programme.title: Triassic Hunt
programme.desc: When two dinosaurs break out of a lab and attack an industrial park, a ragtag group of mercenaries is called in to contain the creatures before they decimate the park and escape into the world.

programme.title: Dracula: The Original Living Vampire

programme.desc: En su despedida de soltero, Félix contrató a dos strippers hermanas y una de ellas era menor de edad. Además, a David le queda poco tiempo de vida por su obesidad a causa de la comida chatarra.
programme.sub-title: Stripper menor de edad; No a la comida chatarra

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Néstor se casó con la exesposa de su amigo Junior y se hizo cargo de su hija, pero ahora la mujer murió. Además, Andrés es un bloguero que fomenta un juego en Internet muy peligroso.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La madre de Arturo tiene alzhéimer y está en un centro de cuidado, pero él quiere sacarla y su esposa se opone. Además, Alejandra tiene una parafilia singular: se excita con el llanto de su esposo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Amanda quiere emanciparse para casarse con un inválido hombre mucho mayor que ella, pero su padre se opone. También, Michelle se enamora de Alex y lo trae a Estados Unidos, pero ella sospecha algo.
programme.sub-title: Inválido caliente; Los 40's son los nuevos 20's

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Dos mujeres y un José; Soloterapia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniel es una chica con aspecto masculino y, para cambiar su identidad, necesita a sus papás. Por otro lado, Paola es la asistente personal de Sandra, una modelo que la sobreexplota.
programme.sub-title: Por las buenas o las malas; La explotadora

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Entre perros y gatos; Hijo putativo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Edwin y Érica se pelean la custodia de una hija con un temperamento muy fuerte. Eduardo dejó a su hermano en México y años después se lo encuentra en Miami con otro género.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Georgina quiere recuperar la custodia de su hijo, pero el papá del niño alega que ella sigue en las drogas. Por otro lado, la hermana de Claudia se puso senos, pero la cirugía se complicó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El suegro de Stefany y Caterine es un delincuente de bienes raíces que las involucró. Por otro lado, Yasiel hizo el reto del desnudo con una chica y ahora la mamá lo amenaza y extorsiona.
programme.sub-title: Sin piso y sin fortuna; Reto al desnudo

programme.sub-title: La bella y el loco; Hermanas cómplices

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Lo pierde todo por sexo; Amante o violador

programme.sub-title: Soy una prostituta; Jugadas del destino

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liz contrató los servicios de un imitador y un DJ para el lanzamiento de una bebida, pero se emborracharon. Perla va a perder su casa y su hermana no puede ayudarla por estar entre pandillas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Bryan está obsesionado con los muñecos y contrata a Antonio para que sea el Ken de su esposa. Anthony trae a su novia de Nueva York para celebrar su cumpleaños, pero se pone celoso de un chico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sonia trajo de Cuba a su novio Pedro para casarse con él, pero en la despedida de soltera tiene sexo con un stripper. El hijo de María murió ahogado con una de las piezas de un Fidget Spinner.
programme.sub-title: Por culpa del tiempo; Fidget Spinner

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Hace años Pedro salvó la vida de las gemelas Gabriela y Daniela, y ahora las chicas se volvieron ingratas. También, Claribel tiene una orden de deportación y no quiere llevarse a su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yahima quiere que su hija abandone la casa porque es una adicta a inhalar chocolate como droga. Por otro lado, la hija de Natalia es autista y en una fiesta tiró al suelo al bebé de Elena.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Verónica tiene una relación con el novio de su madre y cuando se entera la manda a violar. Además, Jaqueline y Pablo tienen una relación laboral online, pero se vuelve sexual.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana es tan celosa y controladora que le implantó a Derick un micro GPS en el pene. En otro caso, a la hija de Teresa la intentaron violar en el estacionamiento de un centro comercial.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Solanch y Marcelo tienen un albergue de gente transgénero, pero Marcelo ahora quiere sacarlos. También, en un viaje de vacaciones, el mar arrastró a la sobrina de Miguel y murió, ahora él tiene un trauma.
programme.sub-title: Refugio para demonios; Se la llevó la corriente

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Danilo toma a Mónica como rehén, y ella le confiesa que está embarazada para ganar tiempo. En cuanto él se distrae, ella lo mata. Con rabia, Aurelio amenaza al Chema por teléfono.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema hace que Rutila grabe un video como prueba de vida para Aurelio, ya que quiere hacer negocios. Andrew obtiene material donde el general Garnica aparece con drogas, con el que pretende chantajearlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor le dice a Ignacio que descubrió su esconditre de armas, y quiere saber si él pertenece al Escuadrón de la Muerte. El Chema y Aurelio se encuentran cara a cara en Villa Catalina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio negocia con el Chema la libertad de Rutila, pero antes deben repartirse los territorios para evitar una guerra. Andrew presiona a Lay: quiere saber sobre sus vínculos con los Casillas.

programme.desc: Rutila seduce al Chema, y logra que él le de su número de teléfono; finalmente, él la entrega a Aurelio. Leonor le confiesa a Victoria que Ignacio trabaja para el Escuadrón de la Muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa entrega a Victoria y Leonor la grabación que incrimina al general Garnica. Leonor la sigue y la encuentra en Villa Catalina. Aurelio, despechado, manda a matar a Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Despechado, Aurelio envía a sus hombres a asesinar a Santiago, pero el atentado se complica cuando Ximena resulta baleada. El Chema averigua que Lay se fue a Colombia, y ordena que la maten.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena acusa a Aurelio de haber mandado a matar a Santiago, y él le ruega no decirle nada a sus hijas. Rutila la ve morir y le dice a su padre que lo hará pagar por esa muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La tormentosa relación de Mónica y Aurelio se quiebra: él le confiesa que sus hombres mataron accidentalmente a Ximena, y que nunca dejó de amarla. Victoria ordena allanar el rancho de Danilo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria se horroriza cuando descubre que Danilo Ferro es en realidad Aurelio Casillas. Chacorta alerta a su hermano de abandonar el funeral de Ximena, porque los de la Marina vienen por ellos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila llama a su padre, le dice que se acostó con su peor enemigo y le da pistas de dónde está. Ahora los Casillas quieren acabar con el Chema, pero solo logran atraer a la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria le tiende una trampa a Aurelio, pero es ella quien paga las consecuencias por traicionarlo. Leonor se enfrenta al Señor de los Cielos, y luego de tantos años, al fin logra capturarlo.

programme.desc: Todos creen que Aurelio Casillas ha muerto en una sala de operaciones. Sin embargo, la muerte que tanto impactó al mundo del narco mexicano es, en realidad, una mentira de quien busca venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio captura al Turco y lo tortura para descubrir dónde está el dinero que le robó. Mientras, el Chema Venegas, desconfiando de los Casillas, ordena a Tijeras secuestrar a doña Alba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de un tiroteo, Chacorta y sus hombres rescatan a doña Alba. El Chema se obsesiona con conocer la verdad sobre la muerte de Aurelio, y pide la lista de doctores que lo operaron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema les ofrece refugio al Turco y la familia de Aurelio en una de sus casas de Los Ángeles para tenderles una trampa. Mónica tiene que matar al cocinero para poder escapar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica vuelve a casa y se encuentra con noticias impactantes. Tras una llamada de su hija Rutila, Aurelio recorre Los Ángeles en busca del Turco y su familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena confiesa que no ama al Turco, que solo sintió agradecimiento por él. Después de matar a Ronnie, Aurelio encuentra a su exesposa, quien le dice que nunca volverá con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de separarse tras el tiroteo, Aurelio y Ximena se reúnen con sus hijos. El Turco usa a Irina para averiguar el paradero de Casillas, y así poder negociar con él.

programme.desc: Matilde quiere aliarse con Chema para hacer un negocio a espaldas de Chacorta. Lay se mete a la tina con Aurelio y, luego de algunas confesiones, pasan una noche de pasión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio visita a Mónica para amenazarla, pero ella recuerda el daño que él le hizo y se defiende. Más tarde, los hombres de Leonor se enfrentan a Chacorta y a Heriberto en una emboscada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Mónica que fingió su muerte para cobrar venganza a sus enemigos. Ximena se reencuentra con su hijo Heriberto, quien necesita de su ayuda para salir del mundo del narcotráfico.

programme.desc: Se planean dos ataques durante la reunión entre el presidente mexicano y el director de la DEA de EE. UU. Luego de una injusta pelea, acusan a Leonor de matar a una prisionera.

programme.desc: Mónica descubre que Aurelio viajará con Lay, y en un ataque de celos, amenaza con matarla. El Cabo busca la ayuda de Robles para viajar a Colombia, y le propone trabajar juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto visita a Ignacio y le pide ayuda para salir del país. Mónica le dispara a Irina para evitar que huya de México. Chema quiere obtener ADN de Aurelio para compararlo con el del cadáver.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto le confiesa a Ximena que se va a Europa para salirse del mundo de la droga. Elsa elige lanzarse como candidata, en lugar de aceptar un puesto en el gabinete presidencial.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor es llevada a juicio, y aunque Ignacio maneja su defensa, la condenan a 15 años. Mientras, Pedro busca el apoyo de Max y Elsa el de Chema durante la campaña para la gubernatura de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio toma al Cabo como rehén y viaja a Colombia, donde toma venganza matando a su hijo. Luego se interna con Mónica en la selva colombiana, él con el nombre de Francisco, ella como Dolores.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio cesa los envíos a Chacorta tras los ataques a las Torres Gemelas, y busca nuevas rutas para pasar la droga. Al campamento llega un infiltrado del Tostado, listo para hacer daño.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leo se debate entre escapar con una compañera de prisión o quedarse y confiar en que Ignacio la libere por vías legales. Mónica le dice a Aurelio que quiere tener un hijo suyo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El general Montoya descubre la verdadera identidad de Francisco, y le pone precio a su silencio. Tras varios años de ausencia, Heriberto regresa a casa y Chacorta lo visita.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema quiere ir a Colombia para descubrir la identidad del mexicano que se está inmiscuyendo en su negocio, y Leonor busca la ayuda del coronel Ramos para liberar a Ponte de la cárcel.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ignacio ofrece casarse con Leonor para que no la deporten. Chacorta le ofrece a Matilde un trato que no puede rechazar. Aurelio amenaza a Gildardo con desmembrarlo si no dice la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le dice a Aurelio que está embarazada, y él quiere construir un laboratorio en territorio venezolano. Chacorta hace una oferta de negocio a Pepe Johnson para vender cocaína por su cuenta.

Since time is of the essence, Billings recruits the chief's son, Taslik (Keith Larsen), to guide the men to the village. However, Billings and his men are unaware that a group of renegades, wary of the suspicious U.S. treaty, seek to kill the messengers before they can complete their mission.

programme.title: Fort Massacre
programme.desc: After his cavalry company is decimated by an Apache attack, Vinson (Joel McCrea) takes charge and tries to lead his remaining men to safety. Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney (Forrest Tucker), question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands.

programme.title: Wichita
programme.desc: After a group of drunken trail riders runs amok, Mayor Andrew Hope (Carl Benton Reid) of Wichita, Kan., recruits the intrepid Wyatt Earp (Joel McCrea) to end lawlessness. Armed and ready for anything, the new marshal decides he will end gun violence simply by banning guns. Soon Earp must face crooked rancher Clint Wallace (Walter Sande) and whiskey slinger Doc Black (Edgar Buchanan), vicious locals who like Wichita exactly as it is and don't take kindly to being told what to do.

programme.title: Gunsight Ridge
programme.desc: Gunslinger Mike Ryan (Joel McCrea) is intent on bringing the dangerous outlaw Velvet Clark (Mark Stevens) to justice. However, Ryan is at a disadvantage, since he doesn't know what the masked robber looks like. Ryan begins to work with the area sheriff and falls for the lawman's pretty daughter, Molly Jones (Joan Weldon). With Clark hiding in plain sight as a piano player, the criminal manages to evade Ryan for a while, but eventually the two adversaries come face-to-face.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: On a train trip, Lucas and Mark find themselves held at gunpoint by a killer.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Ill Mark has a vision of his mother.

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
programme.desc: Gambler and gunman Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rides into Dodge City, Kan., to visit his straight-arrow brother, Ed (Harry Lauter), who is hoping to defeat crooked sheriff Jim Regan (Don Haggerty) in an upcoming election. Bat purchases and renovates a rundown saloon, attracting the notice of Regan's henchmen. A shooting during the saloon's opening-night celebration causes Bat to pursue his own political vendetta against Regan and attempt to clean up the town's corruption once and for all.

programme.title: The Outriders
programme.desc: Three Confederate soldiers escape from Union captivity, only to be captured by bandit Keeley -- then spared when he discovers they're fellow Southerners. Keeley forces them to help with his next planned heist: stealing gold from a wagon train led by Don Antonio Chaves. The men insinuate themselves with Chaves in preparation for the robbery, but when Will (Joel McCrea) falls in love with a widow (Arlene Dahl) traveling with Chaves, the three men must decide whether to continue the plan.

programme.desc: Outlaw Wes McQueen (Joel McCrea) escapes from jail and travels to a meeting with his old partner-in-crime Dave Rickard (Basil Ruysdael). En route, McQueen dispatches a gang of bandits who try to rob the stagecoach and, in the process, wins the attentions of a young woman (Dorothy Malone) with whom he'd like to settle down. Convinced by Rickard to do one last heist, he finds out that his fellow henchmen are not to be trusted and the woman he truly loves is an ex-saloon girl (Virginia Mayo).

But, when the partners in crime are ambushed by Union troops, they have to split up; Seagall escapes with the money, and Brewster gets a five-year jail sentence. When Brewster gets out, he discovers that his old crony is responsible for the death of his beloved wife. With the help of a gunslinger named Getz (Dan Duryea), Brewster embarks on a quest for vengeance.

programme.title: Best of the Badmen
programme.desc: After the North defeats the South, Union Maj. But standing in Clanton's way are the corrupt lawmen Joad (Barton MacLane) and Fowler (Robert Preston), who would rather keep the men outlaws to collect the reward on their heads. After Joad and Fowler frame Clanton for murder, he manages to escape, becoming an outlaw himself.

programme.title: Death Rides a Horse
programme.desc: Having witnessed the brutal murder of his entire family by bandits at the age of 5, Bill Meceita (John Phillip Law) has spent 15 years planning his vengeance. Finding a kindred spirit in Ryan (Lee Van Cleef), an experienced gunslinger seeking his own revenge on those who framed him, the two team up to find and kill Walcott (Luigi Pistilli), a fearsome bandit on the loose. But Bill soon discovers that Ryan may know more about his tragic past than he has let on.

programme.title: A Fistful of Dollars

programme.title: Cabela's Deer Gear TV
programme.desc: Umarex Airguns has hit the market with their newest lineup of airguns for big game hunting. Join us as we go deer hunting with the latest from Umarex Airguns.
programme.sub-title: Air Gun Hunting for Whitetail Deer

programme.title: Just Kill'n Time TV
programme.desc: Buck and Max head to Beaver Creek Outfitters in Meadow Lake Saskatchewan to hunt some gigantic Whitetails.
programme.sub-title: Back in the land of the Giants

programme.title: Slock Master
programme.desc: The Slock Master reveals the tricks and tips that fool predators. Bowhunting coyotes, fox, lion, bobcat and more with incredible close up call ins and amazing archery action. Watch the world's top bow hunter slock em on The Slock Master.

programme.title: Modern Hunter
programme.desc: The Rucks family turns their attention to an often overlooked but critical part of whitetail management-controlling the doe population.

programme.title: Maxed Outdoors
programme.desc: Max Heads up to Olla, Louisiana to meet up with his good buddies, Braydon Price and Matt Busbice, at the Famous Busbice Ranch. All three guys take down mature Louisiana bucks.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: The team breaks down how, when, and where to create mock scrapes to attract and inventory mature bucks on your hunting property. From the science behind licking branches to choosing the perfect locations and using trail cameras to monitor.

programme.title: The Next Bite
programme.desc: Using multiple baits, Korey Sprengel, Alex Reslock and Tyler Elshaug cast the shallows for aggressive walleyes.
programme.sub-title: Multiple Techniques: North Dakota Slough Walleyes

programme.title: University of Fishing
programme.desc: Ben and Charlie fish solo as weather changes and conditions make fishing tough.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles
programme.desc: Curtis was one of three panelists chosen to speak on West Virginia tourism and outdoor recreation at this year's Almost Heaven Classic. After the event and a little golfing, WV DNR Deputy Director Brian Bolyard and Curtis take their kids fly fishing.

programme.title: Seasons on the Fly
programme.desc: Season 07 Episode 03 - Mark Few, head coach of Gonzaga Men's Basketball, joins us as we explore Alaska's Inside Passage in search of silver salmon in saltwater!

programme.title: The High Road With Keith Warren
programme.desc: This week Keith is back at his favorite place to hunt whitetail deer, Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan. Keith is using a crossbow to chase an elusive buck that he has named 9 Lives.

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures
programme.desc: The day started on a multi-generational family cattle ranch. A 40-set skunk line awaited. Young ranchers Preston and Barrett accompanied Mark on their family's land where he's harvested 100's of coyotes in the past.
programme.sub-title: Standing Rock Skunk with Preston, Barrett and Mark

programme.title: Innerloc's Outthere Stories
programme.desc: Brody and his dad head to Kansas to bow hunt for big whitetails. Brody is chasing a nice ten point buck named Spider.

programme.title: Shoot Straight TV
programme.desc: This week Shoot Straight TV has a special guest, a youth hunter who is going after his first mule deer. Wyatt has his Darton bow out and is looking to fill his elk tag. Marsha has a delicious recipe from the field and Chad will give a Straight Talk.
programme.sub-title: First Mule Deer and Filling the Freezer

programme.title: McWhorter Rifles' Precision Hunting TV
programme.desc: The crew from Atlas Development Group travels to Northwest Oklahoma to hunt whitetails during the rifle season with their McWhorter Custom Rifles.

programme.title: Deertopia
programme.desc: In this episode, host Steve reveals strategies for making the most of small properties to create prime whitetail hunting opportunities. From strategic stand placement to habitat improvements, discover how to turn limited acreage into a deer magnet.

programme.title: Carnivore
programme.desc: Carnivore host Gary Roberson calling predators on one of the most celebrated legendary historical western sites in America. He's joined by two most unlikely guests.

programme.title: Hunting After Dark
programme.desc: Jason and Justin meet up with Jeff Charlton of 3C Joppa Cattle Company. Protecting Jeff's Texas Waygu operation by eliminating coyotes and feral hogs.
programme.sub-title: Priorities - Guns, Thermals and Waygu Beef

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: A Giant 200 whitetail and two friends hunting him miles apart. The time is ticking for one to find success.

programme.title: Live The Wild Life
programme.desc: Venture into the untamed wilderness of the Adirondack State Park with Gus and friends on this weeks episode of Live the Wild Life.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Although threatened in their native range, mountain-dwelling tahr thrive in New Zealand; Dan Cabela investigates the challenges of managing a non-native species and balancing ecosystem protection with the economic benefit of hunters harvesting tahr.

programme.title: The Bassquatch Hunter: Fish Out of Water
programme.desc: This episode is a HOMERUN! Mike flew down to Georgia and met up with Atlanta Braves pitcher, Dylan Lee. They caught some BASSQUATCH on the lake and then Mike got to learn how to pitch, throw and hit at Truist Park! Do not miss this action packed fun!
programme.sub-title: Kayak Fishing vs. Atlanta Braves Baseball

programme.title: Wallhanger Tv
programme.desc: It's November 13th in Oklahoma, and Christen Wall is locked in. Watch as she seals the deal on a beautiful whitetail and celebrates a memorable milestone in her hunting journey.

programme.title: Weird Hunts
programme.desc: Invited to Jackie Bushman's camp in Montana, Matt hunts a pinch point on a river where deer have been crossing. With nothing around for cover, he decides to dig a hole to sit in with hopes of taking a mature whitetail.

programme.title: The American Way
programme.desc: Jeremy Severs makes time to hunt for himself and his girls.
programme.sub-title: Jeremy and the Girls hunt Indiana

programme.title: Conquest 200 - Life on a Family Deer Farm
programme.desc: Step behind the scenes of a working whitetail deer farm to discover the real story behind hunting scents. In Farm Chores, Doug Roberts of Conquest Scents reveals the surprising truth about deer urine collection-how it's regulated.

programme.title: Surviving Mann
programme.desc: The sixth episode of Wild Shots Season 1 is here!

programme.title: Maxed Outdoors
programme.desc: Max Heads up to Olla, Louisiana to meet up with his good buddies, Braydon Price and Matt Busbice, at the Famous Busbice Ranch. All three guys take down mature Louisiana bucks.

programme.title: Yamaha's Whitetail Diaries
programme.desc: Filmed in September Airs 1st week November.

programme.title: For Love Or Likes
programme.desc: It's the For Love or Likes Season 2 finale and the girls are not done yet. A buck gets shot on the last morning to make it a 3 way race for the title. The winner is announced and they reflect back on the highlights and lowlights of the week.

programme.title: The Edge
programme.desc: Join EDGE TV host Steve Ecklund as he heads into some familiar territory. He is off to his little honey hole for an early season elk hunt with bow in hand.

programme.title: Doug Koenig's Championship Season
programme.desc: Join Shooting Pro Doug Koenig as he co-hosts the 5th annual Koenig Shooting Sports Precision Rifle Competition with Keith Baker at the Cameo Shooting and Education Complex in Grand Junction Colorado.

programme.title: On The Road
programme.desc: In this episode, Rock and the OTR crew take Rascal Flatts lead singer Gary LeVox out on the water for an epic day of bow fishing before his big concert! They share plenty of laughs and Cajun hospitality..
programme.sub-title: From Bowfishing to the Big Stage

programme.title: Pursue The Wild
programme.desc: In this episode of Pursue the Wild, Kristy Titus takes on a unique bowhunting adventure-pursuing whitetail deer within the city limits in her hometown of Sheridan, Wyoming. Blending urban landscapes with the timeless tradition of archery hunting.

programme.title: Target Rich Environment
programme.desc: It's a busy week in Texas - clients are stacking up for a loaded dove hunt, and when the sun sets, Brett and Austin switch gears for thermal hog action with their Pulsar optics. The fields are full, the guns are loaded, and the action doesn't stop.

programme.title: Red Arrow Tv
programme.desc: Y'all come along with Kip and see if he can track down this BIG Central Texas Whitetail with his bow and arrow! Parental discretion is advised due to extreme blood loss and strong language… just kidding I'm sure it's fine.
programme.sub-title: That's how we roll in the monkey cage!

programme.title: Saltwater Underground with Nick Honachefsky

programme.title: That Old Feeling
programme.desc: Molly De Mora (Paula Marshall) is getting married, with her beau being Keith Marks (Jamie Denton), a political hopeful who is running on a family values platform. Molly invites her now-divorced parents, Lilly (Bette Midler) and Dan (Dennis Farina), to the ceremony, only to see them rekindle their romance despite the fact both are remarried. Fearing a tabloid scandal that could damage Keith's candidacy, Molly sets out to stop them, but the pair have run off and aren't so easily tracked.

programme.title: Change of Habit
programme.desc: Dr. John Carpenter (Elvis Presley) takes the job of running a health center in a low-income district. He enlists three women to help out who -- unbeknownst to him -- are actually nuns in street clothes. The church wants to improve the neighborhood but fears that nuns in full habit would not be well received. Unaware of her unavailability, John falls for Sister Michelle (Mary Tyler Moore), serenading her with his guitar -- which, luckily for him, effectively wears away at her religious resolve.

programme.title: The Electric Horseman
programme.desc: A former champion rodeo rider is reduced to using his saddle skills to promote a breakfast cereal in a gaudy Las Vegas show. When he's asked to perform with a $12 million horse that he discovers is being doped to remain docile, he flees into the desert astride the beast in an act of defiance. A story-hungry female reporter gives chase.

programme.title: Out of Africa
programme.desc: Initially set on being a dairy farmer, the aristocratic Karen Blixen (Meryl Streep) travels to Africa to join her husband, Bror (Klaus Maria Brandauer), who instead spends their money on a coffee plantation. After discovering Bror is unfaithful, Karen develops feelings for hunter Denys (Robert Redford), but realizes he prefers a simplistic lifestyle compared to her upper class background. The two continue on until a series of events force Karen to choose between her love and personal growth.

programme.title: Legal Eagles
programme.desc: Chelsea Deardon (Daryl Hannah) is arrested for stealing artwork painted by her deceased father, and sympathetic attorney Laura Kelly (Debra Winger) sets out to defend the young woman against slick prosecutor Tom Logan (Robert Redford). After a series of romantic exchanges, Tom ends up falling in love with Laura and teaming up with her to help clear Chelsea of the charges. However, as they lawyers dig deeper into the case, things take a shocking turn, and Tom finds his career in jeopardy.

programme.title: Heroes
programme.desc: A troubled Vietnam veteran (Henry Winkler) with plans for a worm farm meets a girl (Sally Field) and hops a bus to California.

programme.title: Raggedy Man
programme.desc: While World War II rages overseas, a divorced mother of two, Nita Longley (Sissy Spacek), struggles to makes ends meet as a telephone operator in small-town Texas. As the subject of disdainful gossip due to her divorce, Nita faces a lonely existence of ostracism, where only the unscrupulous approach her -- often with ill intent. When she befriends Teddy (Eric Roberts), a sailor on leave, her situation improves, but he's soon sent to war. Once again, Nita must face her plight alone.

programme.title: Continental Divide
programme.desc: Chicago reporter Ernie Souchak (John Belushi) is beaten up by double-dealing police officers after he writes about an unethical city councilman. Hoping to keep Ernie safe, his editor, Howard McDermott (Allen Goorwitz), tells him to head west. In Wyoming, Ernie strikes up a romance with bird scientist Nell Porter (Blair Brown), but as soon as he goes home, he's drawn back into city politics. With Nell about to discuss her research in Chicago, this might be the couple's last chance to reunite.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire
programme.desc: Rick Jarmin (Mel Gibson) is put in witness protection after he helps the FBI bust drug dealer Eugene Sorenson (David Carradine). Fifteen years later, he is living with a new identity as a gas station attendant in Detroit. When an old flame named Marianne (Goldie Hawn) stops at the gas station and recognizes him, his cover gets blown. The recently released Sorenson finds out, and both Jarmin and Marianne have to flee across the country with the vengeful Sorenson in hot pursuit.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: Heart and Souls
programme.desc: Harrison (Charles Grodin), Penny (Alfre Woodard), Julia (Kyra Sedgwick) and Milo (Tom Sizemore) die in 1959 when the bus they are riding crashes. The four continue as ghosts, guardians to the child born at the moment of their deaths. Baby Thomas grows up to be a businessman (Robert Downey Jr.) who has memories of his playmates, but assumes they are products of his youthful imagination. When the ghosts realize they need Thomas' help to move on, they decide to make an appearance once more.

programme.title: Cry Baby
programme.desc: A prim and proper schoolgirl goes against her mother's wishes when she dates a motorcycle-riding juvenile delinquent.
